highlights: It is also an ideal place to enjoy the maple leaves.
Even today, people from all over the world come here to pray for success in health, career, exams, sports and love.
Many people come here to pray for "victory" luck.
The temple has a history of 1,300 years and has been visited by dignitaries from all dynasties, including the Minamoto clan and the Ashikaga clan.
Katsuo-ji Temple, originally named "Shengwang Temple", became popular because "king" and "tail" are homophones in Japanese.

globaltix_product_data.name: King Power Mahanakhon Skywalk
globaltix_product_data.summary: Experience breathtaking views of Bangkok at the King Power Mahanakhon Tower, the city’s tallest building standing at an impressive height of 317 metres. Travel to the top aboard one of the world’s fastest video-themed elevators and enjoy spectacular 360-degree views from the indoor Observatory on le...
globaltix_product_data.description: Experience breathtaking views of Bangkok at the King Power Mahanakhon Tower, the city’s tallest building standing at an impressive height of 317 metres. Travel to the top aboard one of the world’s fastest video-themed elevators and enjoy spectacular 360-degree views from the indoor Observatory on levels 74 and 75, featuring beautifully designed observation terraces overlooking Bangkok’s iconic skyline, skyscrapers, and golden temples. For an even more thrilling experience, head up to the outdoor observation deck on the 78th floor for completely uninterrupted panoramic views. If you’re feeling adventurous, step onto the transparent glass floor and look straight down at the city below for an unforgettable perspective. Tickets are available for redemption on the day of visit. Guests can enter King Power Mahanakhon Skywalk directly using the e-ticket issued upon redemption through the reservation portal. Daytime tickets can be redeemed from 8:00 AM on the same day of visit, while sunset tickets can be redeemed from 3:00 PM onwards. Please note that no cancellations or changes are allowed once tickets have been redeemed.
highlights: The Skywalk is located in the King Power Mahanakhon building, which stands tall with 78 floors.
The highlight of the building is the Skywalk, a large observatory on the 74th and 78th floors where you can see all of Bangkok in its glory.
The most exciting part of the Skywalk is the 310-meter-high glass floor you can walk on with views straight down to the streets below.
The Skywalk is definitely worth the price for those who enjoy breathtaking city views and unique experiences.

globaltix_product_data.description: Explore the Kuala Lumpur Bird Park in the Lake Gardens. It is the world's largest free-flight walk-in aviary. A 1-way hotel transfer is included. Visit the Kuala Lumpur Bird Park with this day admission ticket. It is home to more than 3,000 birds of approximately 200 species, and is a renowned eco-tourism destination. Admire the colorful birds flying freely in a beautifully landscaped environment. The park is divided into 4 zones: zones 1, 2 and 3 make up the extraordinary free-flight zones, including the Hornbill Park, which is the park’s main feature. This unique environment closely resembles the birds’ natural habitat with numerous suitable nesting sites, encouraging the birds to breed naturally. In Zone 4 the birds are housed in separate cages and mini aviaries. Marvel at the variety of colorful birds, flying freely in the park Admire and explore the park's tropical environment Enjoy bird feedings and shows scheduled throughout the day

Explore the Hornbill Park and marvel at the sight of the colorful birds freely flying about the area

globaltix_product_data.name: Kryal Castle General Admission
globaltix_product_data.summary: Take a step back in time, and journey inside Australia's only Medieval themed adventure park! Within the walls of Kryal Castle in Victoria, you'll find a sprawling medieval village of activities including jousting tournaments, wizardry, sword battles and much, much more! For lovers of anything pre-1...
globaltix_product_data.description: Take a step back in time, and journey inside Australia's only Medieval themed adventure park! Within the walls of Kryal Castle in Victoria, you'll find a sprawling medieval village of activities including jousting tournaments, wizardry, sword battles and much, much more! For lovers of anything pre-15th century, you'll lose yourself in this fantastic replica village that boasts the aura of the real medieval times. Explore the lavishly decorated castle complete with themed passageways, view the fascinating (and somewhat terrifying) torture chamber exhibition, watch as knights joust to proclaim their bravery and so much more - this unique adventure park will guarantee you hours of fun! Best of all, if visiting with children, Kryal Castle hosts dedicated kids activities including militia training that allows the Kryal children to learn the skills of knighthood including sword fighting and archery. Perfect for all ages, you are bound to find plenty of things to do in Kryal Castle to please everyone! The castle is also home to an on-site accommodation that is also decked out with a medieval theme ensuring all the fun doesn't have to end at the park. Make a weekend out of this great attraction and truly embrace the opportunity to feel like a King or Queen! The castle is open to the public on weekends, selected public holidays and Victorian School Holidays. Book your tickets now and get ready for a very memorable experience that will leave you wanting more! Location: Kryal Castle is just outside Ballarat, one hour from Melbourne. From Melbourne, take the Western Freeway which leads past the townships of Bacchus Marsh and Ballan, to Ballarat
highlights: Australia’s only medieval theme park
Knights, dragons, wizards, kings, queens
Great for families
Located an hour from Melbourne

globaltix_product_data.description: Experience the vibrant cultural tapestry of Kuala Lumpur on a half-day sightseeing tour, perfect for first-time visitors. Discover the unique blend of Muslim, Chinese, Indian, and European influences as you explore the city's most iconic landmarks, including the majestic royal residence of the Istana Negara and the world-renowned Petronas Twin Towers, where you can take a memorable souvenir photo. With flexible departure times in the morning or afternoon and instant confirmation upon booking, this tour offers a hassle-free and enriching introduction to Kuala Lumpur, showcasing its rich history, diverse culture, and stunning architecture. Embark on a captivating half-day sightseeing tour of Kuala Lumpur and explore the city’s most iconic landmarks and cultural gems. This tour offers a unique opportunity to experience the perfect blend of Muslim, Chinese, Indian, and European influences that define the city’s rich history and vibrant diversity. Your journey begins with a visit to the Istana Negara, the majestic royal palace, where you’ll marvel at the stunning architecture and learn about Malaysia’s royal heritage. Continue your exploration with a stop at the famous Petronas Twin Towers, one of the world’s tallest buildings. Don’t forget to snap a souvenir photo in front of these iconic towers, which have become a symbol of Malaysia’s modern progress. This half-day tour is an ideal introduction for first-time visitors, offering a glimpse into the heart of Kuala Lumpur’s culture and history. globaltix_product_data.summary: The Kunsthistorisches Museum (Museum of Art History) is a sumptuous feast of art by Europe's finest artists and artisans. globaltix_product_data.description: The Kunsthistorisches Museum (Museum of Art History) is a sumptuous feast of art by Europe's finest artists and artisans. The collection, amassed by the now extinct House of Habsburg, features many essential Renaissance masterpieces, all contained under an elegant dome.In 1891, Hapsburg Emperor Franz Joseph I opened the on Vienna’s Ringstrasse. The new neoclassical building finally allowed the enormous (and enormously enviable) Habsburg art collection to be housed under one roof. Filled to the brim with masterpieces by some of Europe’s finest artists, it's an experience not to be missed while in Vienna. The building itself is a feast for the eyes - with marbles floors, frescoes, gold leaf and elegant staircases deserve to display awe-inspiring works. And they do.Collected over six hundred years, the artworks here span five millennia. In fact, this museum is every bit the equal of Europe's other 'top line museums' - the Vatican Museums, El Prado, the Louvre. Spanning Ancient Egypt, Classical Rome, and right up to the Renaissance, this collection is a testament to the exquisite taste and formidable power of the House of Habsburg. And with an afternoon here, you'll reap the reward of their diligent art collecting.If you're short on time, head straight for the Picture Gallery, with highlights such as Pieter Bruegel the Elder's , Giuseppe Arcimboldo's , and Raphael's . The mirror image building, across the Maria-Theresien-Platz is the Naturhistorisches Museum (Natural History Museum). It was opened at the same time as its twin - because the accumulated wealth of the Habsburgs required the space. If you can spare it, each museum deserves at least half a day of your time.
highlights: Skip the lines and get two-for-one instant access to two of Vienna's cultural highlights
Admire the Habsburg emperor's world-class art collections, spanning a staggering five millenia of history
See masterpieces by Caravaggio, Raphael, Vermeer, Titian, Rembrandt and more

globaltix_product_data.description: On this land, the first aquarium was born. Rainwater falling between the Tamba Mountains and the Ashiu Primeval Forest turns into clear springs, then streams, soon converging into great rivers that ultimately flow into the sea. The interconnected ecosystem from source to ocean, along with diverse symbiotic life forms, is recreated within the aquarium. Moreover, Kyoto Aquarium is not just about exhibits—it regularly hosts hands-on learning activities like "Close Encounters" and guide sessions led by caretakers. The aquarium aims to become a comprehensive edutainment facility where Kyoto's children can connect with water and its diverse inhabitants. It also reduces energy consumption through solar power and supports breeding programs for Kyoto's rare species. As a flagship facility in an eco-model city, it is committed to nature conservation.
highlights: Experience lively dolphin performances that combine fun, learning, and amazing tricks—perfect for all age groups.
Beautiful tanks featuring jellyfish, tropical fish, and river ecosystems create a peaceful and mesmerizing environment.
Easy to explore, interactive, and weather-proof—ideal for a relaxing and enjoyable visit in Kyoto.
Get a close look at one of the world’s most unique and ancient creatures, found mainly in Japan.
Watch playful penguins in a natural-style habitat, offering great photo moments and family fun.

globaltix_product_data.description: Visit one of Malaysia's top zoos at Langkawi Wildlife Park! Witness unique attractions and marvel at the immense variety of wildlife Langkawi has to offer. Take a walk through the stunning tropical gardens and catch a glimpse of flamingos, mouse-deer, and auricle foxes. Drop by the aviary and be blown away by the incredibly colorful bird species. Don't miss the chance to see emus, pelicans, koi, deer, crocodiles, and otters.
highlights: The park is the first fully-covered wildlife park in Asia.
It offers a unique experience where visitors can have close interactions with animals.
The park is home to more than 150 different animal species.
The park offers a unique mix of fun and excitement for visitors of all ages.
The park is divided into 4 areas (A, B, C, and D), with most of the interaction with the animals happening in areas B and C.

globaltix_product_data.description: Located within the National University of Singapore, the Lee Kong Chian Natural History Museum is home to over one million specimens that tell the story of life’s evolution and the region’s ecological diversity. Visitors can marvel at impressive dinosaur fossils, rare plant collections, and an extensive range of preserved animals that showcase Southeast Asia’s unique biodiversity. Combining science, history, and education, the museum serves as both a research hub and an inspiring destination for anyone fascinated by the natural world.
highlights: The museum houses over a million specimens, including massive dinosaur skeletons, rare plant specimens, and a variety of marine life.
The Lee Kong Chian Natural History Museum is Singapore’s premier natural history museum, dedicated to showcasing the rich biodiversity of Southeast Asia.
Located on the campus of the National University of Singapore
These exhibits vividly depict the evolution of life on Earth, from tiny insects to large mammals, taking you on an extraordinary journey of natural exploration.

globaltix_product_data.name: Legends - The Home of Football
globaltix_product_data.summary: Legends — The Home of Football is Madrid's most immersive and passionately curated football experience — a world-class interactive museum and entertainment destination in the heart of the Spanish capital that celebrates the greatest players, most iconic moments, and most emotionally resonant stories...
globaltix_product_data.description: Legends — The Home of Football is Madrid's most immersive and passionately curated football experience — a world-class interactive museum and entertainment destination in the heart of the Spanish capital that celebrates the greatest players, most iconic moments, and most emotionally resonant stories in the history of the world's most beloved sport. Located in the vibrant Gran Vía district, Legends takes guests on a chronological and thematic journey through football's most extraordinary history — from the sport's Victorian English origins to the golden era of Spanish football, the genius of the greatest players ever to grace the pitch, and the defining moments of World Cups, European Championships, and Champions League finals that have shaped the collective memory of billions of fans across the globe. The museum's extensive collection of authentic football memorabilia — match-worn shirts, signed boots, historical trophies, original contracts, personal artefacts donated by the world's greatest players, and rare photographic and audiovisual archives — is presented through state-of-the-art interactive exhibition design that allows guests to engage with the history of football at multiple levels of depth and personal connection. Interactive skill challenges, immersive audiovisual installations, and holographic presentations bring the greatest moments and most celebrated personalities of football history to vivid life in a format that engages children, casual fans, and the most dedicated football enthusiasts with equal and sustained intensity. As the home city of Real Madrid — the most decorated club in the history of European football — Madrid provides the perfect setting for a museum of this ambition and scope.
highlights: Explore world-class football memorabilia — match-worn shirts, signed boots, historic trophies, and rare personal artefacts from the greatest players in football
Test your skills with interactive football challenges — an engaging and fun dimension that makes Legends a memorable experience for fans of all ages.
A complete football journey from the sport's Victorian origins to the modern era — the most comprehensive and immersive football experience available in Spain.
Experience immersive interactive installations and holographic presentations bringing football's most iconic moments and legendary personalities to vivid life.
Located in Madrid's vibrant Gran Vía district — the perfect football museum destination in the home city of Real Madrid, the world's most decorated club.
inclusions: Access to all 7 floors of the exhibition
Access to 4D cinema, virtual reality, and interactive spaces

globaltix_product_data.description: Make your Dubai vacation as adventurous and fun-filled as possible with our diverse Dubai Parks and Resorts™ passes! Select our Single Day Passes or Multi-Day Pass; each of them offers a variety of flexible options (See our ‘Inclusions’ section for more details). Credited to be the first Integrated Resort in the region, Dubai Parks and Resorts™ has two theme parks, one water park, a Polynesian-themed family resort, and a dedicated retail and dining section, in its colossal 16 million square feet site. Riverland, with a host of leisure, dining and retail choices, serves as the gateway to this resort. With four themed areas including Boardwalk, French Village, the Peninsula and India Gate, it lets visitors step back in time and also revel in several festivals as well as concerts. Motiongate Dubai: This theme park is inspired by Hollywood and features rides, attractions, and entertainment experiences based on popular movies and characters. It brings together three major film studios: DreamWorks Animation, Lionsgate, and Columbia Pictures. Visitors can immerse themselves in the worlds of movies like Shrek, Kung Fu Panda, The Hunger Games, Ghostbusters, and more. Legoland Dubai: Designed specifically for families with children aged 2-12, Legoland Dubai is a park where imagination comes to life. It features a variety of Lego-themed rides, attractions, and building experiences. Children can enjoy driving their own cars, piloting planes, embarking on thrilling adventures, and exploring miniature Lego cities. The park encourages creativity, learning, and fun for kids and their families. Legoland Water Park: Located adjacent to Legoland Dubai, Legoland Water Park is a refreshing water-themed attraction. It offers a combination of exhilarating water slides, splash pools, wave pools, and interactive play areas. Visitors can enjoy the wave pool, float along lazy rivers, build their own Lego rafts, and have a splashing good time. Real Madrid World (RMW): Real Madrid World is the first-ever theme park dedicated to Real Madrid, offering over 40 exciting rides and attractions. Divided into three zones – Champions Avenue, Celebration Plaza, and Stars Avenue – it celebrates the legacy of the world's greatest football club. From the thrilling Hala Madrid Coaster to the immersive Bernabéu Experience, there's something for every fan. Don't miss out on the chance to personalize your very own Real Madrid jersey at our official merchandise store. Welcome to the ultimate destination for families, fans, and theme park enthusiasts alike!
highlights: LEGOLAND® Dubai ensure that there is never dull moment for families with kids from 2 to 12 years.
At MOTIONGATE™ Dubai, take to all rides, games and shows inspired by Hollywood movies.
Smooth entry to region’s largest and one-of-its-kind integrated leisure attraction.
LEGOLAND® Dubai is the first LEGOLAND Park in the Middle East, with six zones such as FACTORY, IMAGINATION, LEGO® CITY, ADVENTURE, KINGDOMS and MINILAND.
Enjoy access to two of your favorite theme parks in the Dubai Parks and Resorts™, which is home to altogether two parks: MOTIONGATE™ Dubai, LEGOLAND® Dubai.

globaltix_product_data.summary: LEGOLAND® Malaysia Resort brings together a LEGOLAND Theme park, Water Park Hotel and SEA LIFE in one LEGO® themed location. It is the ideal family holiday destination with more than 70 hands-on rides, slides, shows and attractions. It is the first of its kind in Asia that offers comprehensive adven...
globaltix_product_data.description: LEGOLAND® Malaysia Resort brings together a LEGOLAND Theme park, Water Park Hotel and SEA LIFE in one LEGO® themed location. It is the ideal family holiday destination with more than 70 hands-on rides, slides, shows and attractions. It is the first of its kind in Asia that offers comprehensive adventure, education and fun for either an action-packed day trip or a short break destination ideal for families with kids aged 2 to 12 years old. The Theme Park is divided into eight themed areas containing thrilling rides, exciting LEGO workshops, awe-inspiring Miniland where Asia’s interesting landscapes, countries and landmarks are recreated in miniature made with more than 30 million LEGO bricks. The Water Park is the largest LEGOLAND Water Park in Asia which features 20 unique slides, waves, wade pools, interactive water-play structure and Build-A-Raft River. SEA LIFE is the world’s largest international aquarium brand with more than 50 outlets in the world and it is the latest addition to LEGOLAND Malaysia Resort. This attraction will immerse all guests in an intimate and interactive journey underneath the waves. All visitors will have chance to enjoy up-close experiences with sea creatures and be inspired to learn more about our blue planet’s invaluable natural marine assets through magical storytelling, interactive displays and hands-on encounters.
highlights: LEGOLAND Malaysia is actively collaborating with the Ministry of Tourism, Arts and Culture (MOTAC) to promote Malaysia as a premier family tourism desitination.
Cultural Immersion: LEGOLAND Malaysia is planning vibrant celebrations like Lunar New Year and Hari Raya, authentically crafted with LEGO bricks.
Exceptional Value: The LEGOLAND Malaysia annual pass offers unbeatable value, with unlimited access, exclusive events, and discounts.
Enhanced Resort Experience: 2024 brings exciting additions to LEGOLAND Malaysia, including shaded structures in MINILAND.

Toddlers under 3 years old enjoy FREE admission to Attractions, Proof of age (NRIC/Passport) is required. Additional information The agent shall ensure that children's tickets must have at least one accompanying adult

LEGOLAND MALAYSIA NEW EVENTS :
  • Usher in the Year of the Horse at LEGOLAND® Malaysia Resort!
  • Step into a season of luck, harmony, and renewal as LEGOLAND® Malaysia Resort ushers in the Year of the Horse. 
    - From 22 January to 22 February 2026, the park will be filled with festive cheer, dazzling performances, and hands-on LEGO® experiences for families and guests of all ages.
  • Venue: Theme Park, The Beginning
Festive Highlights Include:
  • LEGO® Horse Building Activity – Create your own symbol of strength and vitality.
  • LEGO® Orange Tree Making – Craft prosperity and good fortune.
  • LEGO® Chinese Calligraphy Mural – Add your touch to a masterpiece of tradition.
  • Prosperity Minifigure Trading – Swap and collect lucky minifigures.
  • LEGO® Horse Photo Spot & Post-and-Win – Capture memories and share for a chance to win.
  • Fortune Fest Lucky Draw* – Stand a chance to win exciting prizes!
SPECIAL WEEKEND | 17 – 22 February
  • A limited-time celebration featuring traditional performances and festive highlights:
  • Lion Dance Blessing & Acrobatic High Pole
  • Dragon Dance Performance
  • Oriental Live Music
  • Chinese Face Changing
  • Chinese Ancient Drum Show

Transfer: Singapore to Legoland Malaysia - Return Transfer: Singapore to Legoland Malaysia (Weekend)

 

Pick-up point Singapore:

  • Hotel Boss Lobby - 08.30 am
  • Suntec City International Convention and Exhibition Centre (LED large screen) - 08.45 am

Pick-up point Malaysia:

  • LEGOLAND Coach Bay - 17.30 pm
options.termsAndConditions:
LEGOLAND Malaysia Resort

  • Toddlers under 3 years old enjoy FREE admission to Attractions, Proof of birth date is required, eg: birth cert, etc..
  • The agent shall ensure that children's tickets must have at least one accompanying adult
  • The 2-day ticket is valid for use on two consecutive days only.

Transfer: Singapore to Legoland Malaysia - Return Transfer: Singapore to Legoland Malaysia (Weekend)

  • The ticket is valid on the selected date only
  • Once the invoice issued the tickets is confirmed and cannot be cancelled unless informed by merchant
  • Please gather at your point at least 30 minutes before departure time. Look for the LEO CITY tour bus.
  • The passport must be valid for more than 6 months from the date of travel
  • A visa might be required for some nationality

  • Usher in the Year of the Horse at LEGOLAND® Malaysia Resort!
  • Step into a season of luck, harmony, and renewal as LEGOLAND® Malaysia Resort ushers in the Year of the Horse. 
    - From 22 January to 22 February 2026, the park will be filled with festive cheer, dazzling performances, and hands-on LEGO® experiences for families and guests of all ages.
  • Venue: Theme Park, The Beginning
Festive Highlights Include:
  • LEGO® Horse Building Activity – Create your own symbol of strength and vitality.
  • LEGO® Orange Tree Making – Craft prosperity and good fortune.

  • Prosperity Minifigure Trading – Swap and collect lucky minifigures.
  • LEGO® Horse Photo Spot & Post-and-Win – Capture memories and share for a chance to win.
  • Fortune Fest Lucky Draw* – Stand a chance to win exciting prizes!

globaltix_product_data.summary: Make your Dubai vacation as adventurous and fun-filled as possible with our diverse Dubai Parks and Resorts™ passes! Select our Single Day Passes or Multi-Day Pass; each of them offers a variety of flexible options (See our ‘Inclusions’ section for more details). Credited to be the first Integrated...
globaltix_product_data.description: Make your Dubai vacation as adventurous and fun-filled as possible with our diverse Dubai Parks and Resorts™ passes! Select our Single Day Passes or Multi-Day Pass; each of them offers a variety of flexible options (See our ‘Inclusions’ section for more details). Credited to be the first Integrated Resort in the region, Dubai Parks and Resorts™ has two theme parks, one water park, a Polynesian-themed family resort, and a dedicated retail and dining section, in its colossal 16 million square feet site. Riverland, with a host of leisure, dining and retail choices, serves as the gateway to this resort. With four themed areas including Boardwalk, French Village, the Peninsula and India Gate, it lets visitors step back in time and also revel in several festivals as well as concerts. Motiongate Dubai: This theme park is inspired by Hollywood and features rides, attractions, and entertainment experiences based on popular movies and characters. It brings together three major film studios: DreamWorks Animation, Lionsgate, and Columbia Pictures. Visitors can immerse themselves in the worlds of movies like Shrek, Kung Fu Panda, The Hunger Games, Ghostbusters, and more. Legoland Dubai: Designed specifically for families with children aged 2-12, Legoland Dubai is a park where imagination comes to life. It features a variety of Lego-themed rides, attractions, and building experiences. Children can enjoy driving their own cars, piloting planes, embarking on thrilling adventures, and exploring miniature Lego cities. The park encourages creativity, learning, and fun for kids and their families. Legoland Water Park: Located adjacent to Legoland Dubai, Legoland Water Park is a refreshing water-themed attraction. It offers a combination of exhilarating water slides, splash pools, wave pools, and interactive play areas. Visitors can enjoy the wave pool, float along lazy rivers, build their own Lego rafts, and have a splashing good time. Real Madrid World (RMW): Real Madrid World is the first-ever theme park dedicated to Real Madrid, offering over 40 exciting rides and attractions. Divided into three zones – Champions Avenue, Celebration Plaza, and Stars Avenue – it celebrates the legacy of the world's greatest football club. From the thrilling Hala Madrid Coaster to the immersive Bernabéu Experience, there's something for every fan. Don't miss out on the chance to personalize your very own Real Madrid jersey at our official merchandise store. Welcome to the ultimate destination for families, fans, and theme park enthusiasts alike!
highlights: LEGOLAND® Dubai ensure that there is never dull moment for families with kids from 2 to 12 years.
At MOTIONGATE™ Dubai, take to all rides, games and shows inspired by Hollywood movies.
Smooth entry to region’s largest and one-of-its-kind integrated leisure attraction.
LEGOLAND® Dubai is the first LEGOLAND Park in the Middle East, with six zones such as FACTORY, IMAGINATION, LEGO® CITY, ADVENTURE, KINGDOMS and MINILAND.
Enjoy access to two of your favorite theme parks in the Dubai Parks and Resorts™, which is home to altogether two parks: MOTIONGATE™ Dubai, LEGOLAND® Dubai.

There will be no refund for unused or partially used services. Children must be accompanied by an adult at all times. Guests are prohibited from bringing food and drinks into the Park. Transfer timings may be modified by 30 to 60 minutes, depending on traffic conditions and your location.  Some activities may not be operational due to Maintenance or up-gradation and are Subject to Availability Real Madrid World is the latest addition to Dubai Parks and Resorts, operating from Sunday to Thursday, 12:00 pm to 9:00 pm, and Friday and Saturday, 12:00 pm to 10:00 pm. Our terms and conditions prohibit eating, drinking, and smoking inside the vehicle during any tour that includes transfer services. Legoland water park is closed on Wednesdays.

Located in Nagoya, LEGOLAND® Japan offers over 40 exciting rides, interactive attractions, and live shows across themed zones designed to bring LEGO bricks to life. From flying through the skies in LEGO-themed coasters to building your own creations, this park promises a full day of fun, creativity, and unforgettable memories.

reat photo spots with life-sized LEGO figures and creative structures.
Explore 7 themed zones, such as Bricktopia, Pirate Shores, Knight’s Kingdom, and LEGO City.
Enjoy live shows and entertainment suitable for all ages.

options.description: The opening hours of Legoland vary depending on the day. Please check here for more operating hours details. 【Important Information】 Please note that the park may temporarily close, shorten its operating hours, or suspend certain operations without prior notice due to inclement weather, facility maintenance, or other operational reasons. Attractions, displays, and facilities may be changed, closed, or removed without notice due to technical or operational circumstances. Operation of attractions and entertainment programs may be canceled without prior notice. To ensure food safety and comfort for all guests enjoying the world of LEGOLAND® Japan, bringing food and beverages into the park is generally not permitted. However, the following items are allowed as exceptions: Water bottles (approx. 500ml) Meals for guests with food allergies Baby food Children aged 12 and under must be accompanied by someone aged 16 or older to enter the park. Pets are not allowed in the park, except for guide dogs, hearing dogs, and service dogs. Smoking is prohibited inside the park except in designated smoking areas. For the safety of all guests, we may inspect your belongings at the entrance. From January 8, 2024, for safety reasons, items such as outdoor wagons, push tricycles, and carry-on suitcases are no longer permitted inside LEGOLAND® Japan.
options.termsAndConditions: Child rates apply to all guests aged 18 and under. Tickets are non-refundable and cannot be canceled. The full name of the ticket holder must be printed on the ticket. If the name is not shown, or if it is determined that the name does not match the actual guest, you may be asked to present identification. Entry may be denied if identity cannot be verified. Tickets may not be exchanged for cash or resold. Tickets that are forged or used fraudulently will be deemed invalid. If tickets are booked for a group, all members must enter the park together. If you are unable to visit on the reserved date due to unavoidable circumstances, a date change is possible under the following conditions: The new visit date must be within 3 months from the original date of entry. (e.g., for a ticket dated Feb. 20, it may be changed until May 20.) No prior notice is required. Please visit the park on your preferred date and proceed to the ticket counter. A handling fee of 500 yen per ticket will apply for the date change. Each ticket can only be changed once.

globaltix_product_data.description: Add a distinct splash of adventure, excitement, and innovative invention to your water park experience in Dubai! With Rayna Tours, set out to delve into the amazing world of Legoland Water Park, offering more than 20 immersive rides and slides exclusively for families with kids aged from two to 12 years.
highlights: Get the chance to build your own raft with the colorful LEGO® bricks.
Enjoy stress-free entry to the region’s first water park exclusively themed around LEGO®
Experience pulse-racing adventure and fun with Splash out, Slide Racers, Red Rush and Twin Chasers, among other.
Take to its 20 plus cool games, rides, and slides particularly designed for families of kids aged between 2 and 12 years.
Let your toddlers make the most of DUPLO Splash Safari with fun-filled mini slides.
globaltix_product_data.termsAndConditions: Please carry a Photo ID with you as it may be asked at the time of your entrance. The pick-up will be arranged from your Dubai Hotel / Residence only. There will be no refund for unused or partially used services. Children must be accompanied by an adult at all times. Guests are prohibited from bringing food and drinks into the Park. Transfer timings may be modified by 30 to 60 minutes, depending on traffic conditions and your location.  Free Parking for Visitors and Valet Service for AED 100 only (excluding buggy drop-off).  Our terms and conditions prohibit eating, drinking, and smoking inside the vehicle during any tour that includes transfer services.
globaltix_product_data.address: Parks & Resorts - Sheikh Zayed Rd - Dubai - United Arab Emirates

options.name: Legoland Water Park- Day Pass -  Summer Offer 2025 - Private Transfer
options.description: A fun-filled section of the enormous Dubai Parks and Resorts and located close to Legoland Dubai Theme Park, this one-of-a-kind family water park has everything to ensure an imaginatively action-packed day. Glide and slip your way along its amazing rides as well as slides including Splash Out and the six-lane Slide Racers. To enthrall your toddlers, there is DUPLO Splash Safari, complete with four mini slides and life-sized Lego characters. Alternatively, its exclusive fun playground, Joker Soaker, has something to delight all preferences. For thrill seeking kids, attractions like Red Rush and Twin Chasers are second to none. Want to try something creative with your little ones? Let your tiny tots work with Lego bricks to build their own raft and enjoy a personalized ride. You can even make it an absolute family amusement by joining all your family members to create your own boat.

globaltix_product_data.summary: The Leopold Museum houses one of the most important collections of early 20th-century Austrian art. Housed in Vienna's popular MuseumsQuartier, the Leopold's dense collection features artists such...
globaltix_product_data.description: The Leopold Museum houses one of the most important collections of early 20th-century Austrian art. Avid art collectors Rudolf and Elisabeth Leopold collected more than 5,000 exhibits over five decades. Housed in Vienna's popular MuseumsQuartier, the Leopold's dense collection features artists such as Egon Schiele, Gustav Klimt, Oskar Kokoschka and Richard Gerstl. The collection was consolidated in 1994, and in 2001 the museum opened its doors to the public.When young medical student Rudolf Leopold purchased his first work of art in his mid-twenties, nobody could have predicted that it would become an obsession. Forty years later Rudolf Leopold consolidated more than 5,000 artworks and objects into a private foundation valued at 575 million Euros. The collection, in its permanent home in a museum purpose-built by the Austrian state, is the largest and most-visited museum in Vienna's MuseumsQuartier.The main focus of the collection is Austrian art of the first half of the 20th century, and includes the world's largest collection of works by the influential Austrian Expressionist Egon Schiele. The focus is his radical and expressive works, created between 1910 and 1915. There's also an impressive set of works by world-renowned artist Gustav Klimt - co-founder of the Vienna Secession in 1897. The permanent exhibition allows visitors to experience the diversity of an era marked by the idea of the , (a 'total work of art' that permeates all aspects of life). The works on display here include Expressionist paintings, pieces from the Vienna Secession, and masterpieces of the Wiener Werkstätte - the Viennese arts and crafts movement.
highlights: The world's largest collection of works by Austrian Expressionist Egon Schiele
Highlights include works by Gustav Klimt (Death and Life) and Oskar Kokoschka (Tre Croci)

globaltix_product_data.description: Palacio de Liria is one of Madrid's best-kept secrets — a magnificent 18th-century neoclassical palace nestled behind high walls in the Argüelles neighbourhood. For generations the private residence of the House of Alba, Spain's most illustrious aristocratic family, the palace houses an extraordinary private art collection rivalling many of Europe's great public museums. Recently opened to limited public visits following extensive restoration, Liria Palace offers one of the most exclusive and memorable cultural experiences in Madrid.

Highly limited visitor numbers creating an intimate and privileged sightseeing experience
A hidden gem that offers a fascinating insight into Spanish aristocratic history and culture

globaltix_product_data.description: Lisbon's incredible coastline makes for a different view of the city from your comfy hop-on hop-off boat. For 24 hours, your pass gives you access to a new perspective and a host of fun Lisbon sights and activities along the way!It's special enough from the ground, but from the water, the '7 Hills City' really comes to life.Hop aboard your boat and glide along the glimmering Tagus, taking in the city's many colorful houses perched on the hills, and important monuments like the fortified Belém Tower, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. There's also the famous Monument of the Discoveries, the ideal place to sit down by the water and enjoy the atmosphere.Don't miss the statue of Cristo-Rei at the Cristo Rei Sanctuary in the locality of Almada, right across Lisbon on the south bank of the river!Want more? Your pass includes free access to any Carris tram, the Santa Justa Lift, and Lisbon funiculars.Know before you go Departure Terreiro do Paço 18:00 (only on Tuesday, Thursdays and Sundays) Departure Belém: daily at 19:00

globaltix_product_data.description: The London Dungeon is a thrilling and immersive attraction that takes visitors on a spine-chilling journey through the darker side of London's history. With live actors, gruesome special effects, and captivating storytelling, it brings to life some of the city's most notorious moments, including the gruesome tales of Jack the Ripper, the terrifying story of the Great Plague, and the infamous Torture Chamber. It’s an exciting mix of horror, history, and humor, perfect for those seeking a unique and frightful experience in the heart of London.

globaltix_product_data.description: Soar above the heart of London with a ride on the iconic London Eye. Located on the South Bank of the River Thames, this giant observation wheel offers breathtaking 360-degree views of the city’s most famous landmarks, including Big Ben, the Houses of Parliament, Buckingham Palace, and St. Paul’s Cathedral. Step into a spacious, air-conditioned glass capsule and enjoy a slow 30-minute rotation that offers plenty of photo opportunities and a peaceful moment above the bustling city.

globaltix_product_data.summary: The London Afternoon Tea Bus with Panoramic Tour is one of the British capital's most charming and uniquely memorable experiences, combining the beloved tradition of English afternoon tea with a leisurely sightseeing tour aboard a beautifully converted vintage Routemaster double-decker bus. globaltix_product_data.description: The London Afternoon Tea Bus with Panoramic Tour is one of the British capital's most charming and uniquely memorable experiences, combining the beloved tradition of English afternoon tea with a leisurely sightseeing tour aboard a beautifully converted vintage Routemaster double-decker bus. Most commonly operated by BB Bakery, this experience rolls through the heart of London's most iconic streets and landmarks while guests are treated to a freshly prepared afternoon tea service at their seats — a delightful fusion of culinary indulgence and effortless sightseeing that has made it a firm favourite among tourists and locals alike. The tour departs from a central London location near Trafalgar Square, making it easily accessible from most parts of the city. The afternoon tea menu is freshly prepared on the day and served with care by attentive onboard staff as the bus glides past some of London's most celebrated landmarks. Guests enjoy a classic selection of finger sandwiches with artisan fillings, freshly baked warm scones served with clotted cream and jam, an assortment of handcrafted pastries and cakes, and a generous pot of premium loose-leaf tea or coffee. The upper deck of the vintage bus offers panoramic open views through large windows, allowing guests to take in the grandeur of Buckingham Palace, Westminster Abbey, the Houses of Parliament, Big Ben, St Paul's Cathedral, Tower Bridge, and many more of the city's defining sights — all without stepping off the bus or navigating through crowds on foot. The tour runs for approximately 1.5 hours and follows a carefully planned route through central and riverside London, designed to maximise landmark coverage while maintaining a smooth and relaxed pace throughout the tea service. Tickets are available online in advance and must be booked ahead of time, as the intimate capacity of the bus means sessions sell out regularly, particularly during weekends and the busy summer tourist season. The experience is entirely seated and sheltered, operating year-round regardless of weather, and is suitable for a wide range of guests including families, couples, and group celebrations. Vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free afternoon tea options are typically available upon prior request at the time of booking.
highlights: Savour a freshly prepared classic English afternoon tea — finger sandwiches, scones, pastries, and premium tea — served onboard as you tour London.
Operates aboard a beautifully restored vintage Routemaster bus with panoramic windows offering unobstructed views of the London streetscape throughout.
Cruise past London's most iconic landmarks including Buckingham Palace, Big Ben, Tower Bridge, and St Paul's Cathedral from a vintage double-decker bus.
A unique two-in-one experience combining a panoramic sightseeing tour and traditional afternoon tea in approximately 1.5 hours of relaxed luxury.
Dietary alternatives including vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free menus are available on request, making the experience inclusive for all guests.

globaltix_product_data.description: Experience the perfect merge of classic art and majestic architecture in the Arabian Peninsula’s first universal museum. Designed by the award-winning French architect, Jean Nouvel, Louvre Abu Dhabi is an impressive spectacle on water. Its legendary name says it all! Backed by loans from legendary museums like Musée du Louvre, Musée d’Orsay, and Centre Pompidou, Louvre Museum Abu Dhabi is a collaborative effort between the governments of Abu Dhabi and France.
highlights: This not only lets you access the Arabian world’s first universal museum, but also experience the world’s only Louvre Museum outside of Paris.
Beyond its celebrated exhibits, the museum stands out for its brilliant architecture, designed by the award-winning architect - Jean Nouvel.
Have a closer look at classic masterworks including the Self-Portrait of Van Gogh and Leonardo da Vinci’s La Belle Ferronnière painting.
See some distinct exhibits including a 3000-year-old bracelet.
Discover over 600 artistic displays arranged in 12 sequences, allowing you to experience all civilizations beginning from pre-historic era.

options.name: Louvre Museum Tickets - Private transfer
options.description: Travel through Different Periods & Distinct Civilizations With loans from legendary museums like Musée du Louvre, Musée d’Orsay, and Centre Pompidou, Louvre Abu Dhabi showcases a vast spectrum of objects depicting ancient and the latest contemporary artistic expressions in its massive 86,000-square-foot facility. With its hundreds of exhibits presented chronologically, it will take you through distinct periods, from the pre-historic times and the birth of Islam to the classical age and modern era. Marvel at Captivating Architecture & Inspiring Location Louvre Abu Dhabi Universal Museum is truly an impressive spectacle on water. Designed by the award-winning French architect Jean Nouvel, it encompasses a series of stunning white structures that reflect an Arabian city. In fact, it forms one of the main highlights of the thriving Saadiyat Cultural District, which also hosts museums including the Zayed National Museum and the Guggenheim Museum. globaltix_product_data.summary: Explore the Louvre at your own pace with a timed-entrance ticket, ensuring you get in within 30 minutes. See unmissable and iconic artwork such as the Mona Lisa and Venus de Milo. Discover Renaissance masterpieces and ancient Egyptian relics, along with paintings from the 13th to 20th centuries. The...
globaltix_product_data.description: Explore the Louvre at your own pace with a timed-entrance ticket, ensuring you get in within 30 minutes. See unmissable and iconic artwork such as the Mona Lisa and Venus de Milo. Discover Renaissance masterpieces and ancient Egyptian relics, along with paintings from the 13th to 20th centuries. The museum first opened on August 10, 1793, exhibiting just 537 paintings. Despite closing in 1796 due to structural problems, it reopened in 1801 as the Musée Napoléon with a larger collection. The collection has since gained 20,000 works. Now, there are 8 departments: Egyptian Antiquities; Near Eastern Antiquities; Greek, Etruscan, and Roman Antiquities; Islamic Art; Sculpture; Decorative Arts; Paintings; and Prints and Drawings.
highlights: Benefit from fast and easy skip-the-ticket-line entrance

Marvel at works of art, from Ancient Egypt to the Renaissance

globaltix_product_data.description: Madame Tussauds London is one of the world’s most famous wax museums, offering an incredible experience where you can get up close with life-like wax figures of celebrities, historical figures, sports stars, and more. Located in the heart of London, this attraction is a must-visit for those looking to experience a unique blend of art, entertainment, and culture. With over 250 incredibly realistic wax figures spread across themed areas, visitors can interact with their favorite personalities and take memorable photos. From the royal family to movie stars, pop icons, and global leaders, Madame Tussauds London brings a wide array of figures to life in an engaging and immersive setting.

Walk through themed zones and immerse yourself in dynamic displays where you can engage with the figures in various poses.

globaltix_product_data.description: Nanjing Road Pedestrian Street runs roughly east-west for 1,500 m from People’s Square to the Bund. Known to some as China’s Fifth Avenue, it is a premiere shopping destination with many well-known brands filling the retail space. After dark the street glows with light from all the signage and store displays. On most nights, the area is packed with a mixture of locals and tourists hunting for bargains or trying to find a table at one of the many restaurants. Given its central location and popularity, Nanjing Road Pedestrian Street should be on anyone’s must-see list of Shanghai attractions.

globaltix_product_data.summary: Zoo Aquarium de Madrid is one of Spain’s leading zoological parks, located in the Casa de Campo area of Madrid. The attraction combines a large zoo, modern aquarium, aviary, and family-friendly educational experiences across spacious themed habitats representing wildlife from five continents. Visito...
globaltix_product_data.description: Zoo Aquarium de Madrid is one of Spain’s leading zoological parks, located in the Casa de Campo area of Madrid. The attraction combines a large zoo, modern aquarium, aviary, and family-friendly educational experiences across spacious themed habitats representing wildlife from five continents. Visitors can explore diverse animal zones while learning about conservation and biodiversity in an immersive outdoor setting. The park is home to iconic species including giant pandas, koalas, gorillas, Asian elephants, Iberian lynxes, red pandas, sharks, sea turtles, and exotic birds. Highlights include the aquarium with multiple marine exhibits, interactive aviary experiences, educational presentations, and themed habitats such as the gorilla territory and Little Farm area designed for younger visitors. The zoo also focuses on wildlife conservation and habitat preservation through educational programs and breeding initiatives. Most visitors spend around half a day to a full day exploring the attraction depending on their pace and interest in the exhibits. Guests can enter using pre-booked or mobile tickets and follow a self-guided route through the park’s outdoor and indoor areas. The spacious layout allows flexible pacing with opportunities to stop for animal feedings, educational talks, rest areas, and family-friendly activities throughout the visit.
highlights: Explore animal habitats from five continents in one of Spain’s largest zoo and aquarium attractions.
Visit the aquarium featuring marine species, coral displays, sea turtles, and large shark tanks.
Flexible self-guided visit suitable for families, couples, students, and wildlife enthusiasts.
Enjoy family-friendly educational zones, aviaries, and interactive wildlife experiences.
See iconic species including giant pandas, koalas, gorillas, sharks, and Asian elephants.

globaltix_product_data.name: Prado Museum Guided Tour
globaltix_product_data.summary: The Prado Museum is one of the world's greatest art museums — a collection of European painting and sculpture assembled by the Spanish Crown over three centuries that stands as an unparalleled concentration of artistic genius, encompassing the world's finest collection of Spanish painting alongside...
globaltix_product_data.description: The Prado Museum is one of the world's greatest art museums — a collection of European painting and sculpture assembled by the Spanish Crown over three centuries that stands as an unparalleled concentration of artistic genius, encompassing the world's finest collection of Spanish painting alongside exceptional holdings of Flemish, Italian, and Dutch masters that together constitute a comprehensive survey of European art from the 12th to the 19th century. The Amigo Tours guided experience transforms what can be an overwhelming encounter with over 8,000 works into a carefully curated and deeply rewarding journey through the museum's most significant and historically resonant masterpieces. The guided tour focuses on the Prado's most celebrated treasures — Velázquez's Las Meninas, considered by many art historians the greatest painting ever created, Goya's devastating Black Paintings and the confrontational Third of May 1808, El Greco's spiritual intensity in The Trinity, and Hieronymus Bosch's bewildering The Garden of Earthly Delights among the works that receive the guide's most detailed and illuminating attention. The expert commentary contextualises each work within the broader history of European art and the specific cultural and political circumstances of the Spanish court that commissioned and collected these extraordinary paintings.

Enjoy an enriching experience guided by an expert
Enjoy expert commentary from a professional licensed guide
Discover the fascinating stories behind each artwork
Learn about royal portraits, religious, and mythological scenes
Admire masterpieces by Velázquez, Goya, El Greco, and Rubens
Visit lesser-known corners of the museum with hidden gems

globaltix_product_data.description: Destination Pass Singapore (Mandai Wildlife Reserve) is a multi-attraction pass offering access to Singapore’s top wildlife parks within Mandai. This nature-based experience includes renowned attractions such as Singapore Zoo, River Wonders, Bird Paradise, and other selected parks depending on the pass type. Visitors can enjoy diverse wildlife encounters, immersive habitats, and educational exhibits in one convenient package. It is an ideal choice for nature lovers and families seeking value and flexibility. The recommended duration is a full-day experience, depending on the number of parks included in the pass. The experience is self-paced, allowing guests to visit selected attractions at their convenience within the validity period. Duration may vary based on crowd levels, weather conditions, and chosen itinerary. Guests can enter each attraction using a e-ticket for direct admission or redeem tickets at the counter if required. Depending on the selected pass, visitors can access multiple wildlife parks within Mandai Wildlife Reserve. Guests can explore each park at their own pace, enjoying animal exhibits, shows, and interactive experiences. The pass allows flexible planning, enabling visitors to visit multiple attractions across the same day or separate days within the validity period.
highlights: Enjoy access to multiple top attractions in Singapore with one convenient and value-for-money pass.
Perfect for first-time visitors, families, and travelers looking to explore Singapore efficiently.
Visit multiple theme parks in a single day, hopping between thrilling rides, captivating shows, and exciting experiences
Includes entry to selected attractions based on pass type, offering flexibility and savings.
Ideal for all traveler types seeking a hassle-free way to discover Singapore’s top highlights.

Important Notes This bundle is not in conjunction with any other ongoing promotion. How to Get There Mandai Wildlife Reserve is located in the northern part of Singapore. Accessible by taxi, ride-hailing services, or public buses from MRT stations. Parking is available on-site for private vehicles.

options.name: Night Safari + Exploria
options.description: Night Safari Identification may be required upon redemption. The turnstiles will relocate to Night Safari’s entrance and open at 6:30pm daily, a valid admission ticket is required to enjoy Night Safari’s dining (Ulu Ulu Safari Restaurant) and shopping options when you enter at your booked timeslot. Night Safari will operate daily from 7.15pm to 12am. Night safari tram ride arrives every 15 minutes from the entrance and can take up to 60 persons in each Tram. Creatures of the Night (Approx. 25 mins) at Night Safari Amphitheatre, time: 7:30pm, 8:30pm & 9:30pm Guests MUST NOT leave the amphitheatre while the presentation is going on. Tourist Guides and Tour Leaders must ensure their guests sit through the whole presentation and only leave the amphitheater after the presenter announces the presentation has ended. STB Tourist Guide caught leaving the premises early will be barred from future entry to Night Safari. Seats for the Creatures of the Night presentation must be reserved through the booking portal 2 hours before each presentation at: https://www.mandai.com/en/book-presentation-seats.html Twilight Performance (Approx. 5 mins) at Night Safari Entrance Courtyard, time: 8:00pm & 9:00pm Click here to find out more activities line up: https://www.mandai.com/en/night-safari/things-to-do/activities.html Important Notes: Please be informed that the fire hybrid performance at 8pm and 9pm daily at the Night Safari entrance courtyard will be replaced with a new LED light performance, until further notice. We would like to remind you to ensure that your coach drivers avoid using Coach Bay 3 and 5 at Mandai Wildlife East (Singapore Zoo, Night Safari side). These bays are designated exclusively for the Mandai City Express (MCE) and Mandai Khatib Shuttle (MKS) services to facilitate smooth operations. To avoid congestion and delays, we kindly request that your drivers utilize other available coach bays for drop-offs and parking. Exploria Discover a new dimension of wildlife exploration at Exploria – Mandai Wildlife Reserve, an immersive indoor experience designed to spark curiosity about the natural world. Located within Mandai Wildlife Reserve, Exploria blends interactive storytelling, multimedia installations, and educational exhibits to bring wildlife conservation and biodiversity to life. Through engaging displays and hands-on activities, visitors can explore fascinating ecosystems, learn about animal habitats, and understand the importance of protecting our planet. The experience is thoughtfully designed for families, students, and nature enthusiasts seeking both fun and meaningful learning. Operating Hours: Mon – Fri: 11:00 am – 8:00 pm (Last Entry 7:00 pm) Sat, Sun & Public Holiday: 11:00 am – 9:00 pm (Last Entry 8:00 pm) With effect from 1 July 2026. options.name: mammoth cave self-guided audio tour
options.description: Lying beneath the surface of Leeuwin-Naturalist Ridge, a series of decorated limestone caves can be found. Join this guided tour of the Mammoth Caves in Margaret River and wander through the caves while listening to an informative audio tour that leads you around the majestic chambers. The Mammoth Caves are the most accessible of all caves in Margaret River with boardwalks and platforms that are wheelchair accessible for all guests. Marvel at this natural time capsule and ancient fossil including the remains of Australian Megafauna that have been extinct for approximately 46,000 years. The Mammoth Caves are open daily between 9am to 5pm with the last entry to the caves at 4pm. Inclusions * Self-guided audio tours of the Mammoth Cave * Access to the interpretative centre onsite Time * Tours depart between 9am and 5pm * Self-guided audio tours and last entry 4pm * Closed Christmas Day Location * Caves Rd, Forest Grove, WA, 6285. Just 15 minutes drive south of Margaret River, along Caves Rd What To Bring * Enclosed footwear suitable for climbing stairs is recommended * Bring hats and sunscreen in summer, waterproof jackets in winter * Camera (no tripods, camera stands or selfie-sticks) Additional Information * Enclosed footwear suitable for climbing stairs is recommended * Photography permitted but no tripods, camera stands or selfie-sticks * Arrival at the ticket counter 10 minutes prior to tour time is required. During busy holiday periods your place on the tour may be reallocated if you have not checked in 5 minutes prior to tour departure * Child age is 4-16 yrs. Children under 4 years old are not permitted on the tour Cancellation Policy * A full refund will be provided for cancellations received by close of business (5pm WST) on the day prior to the tour booking * In the event of ‘no shows’, or cancellations later than close of business (5pm WST) on the day prior to the booking, the operator may charge the full cost of the booked tour Booking Information * Confirmation in the form of a tour voucher will be received at time of booking * Upon completion of purchase, please print the voucher and present on day of the experience * Mobile Vouchers are accepted! - Vouchers can also be presented on your mobile device for this attraction * For your information, complete Tour Operator Information including contact details is included on your tour voucher * Availability was accurate at the time of booking however, is subject to change due to circumstances out of our control * We strongly suggest reconfirming your booking with the tour operator within 24 hours of making your booking and prior to making other travel arrangements

globaltix_product_data.description: Book the Ngilgi Cave Tour in Margaret River to go below the earth’s surface and enter the exquisitely decorated cave. This semi-guided tour will last for one hour will an introductory talk from a cave guide in the first chamber known as The Amphitheatre. Admire the spectacular shawls, helictites, stalagmites and stalactites at your own pace. Explore the cave at your own pace and hear the stories of the early exploration of the cave with guides available to answer any questions you might have along the way. The Ngilgi Cave derives its name from a local Aboriginal legend and the cave’s interpretive area details the interesting history of the caves. Book your tickets for the Ngilgi Cave online here to discover more.

This semi-guided tour will last for one hour will an introductory talk from a cave guide in the first chamber known as The Amphitheatre. Admire the spectacular shawls, helictites, stalagmites and stalactites at your own pace. Explore the cave at your own pace and hear the stories of the early exploration of the cave with guides available to answer any questions you might have along the way. The Ngilgi Cave derives its name from a local Aboriginal legend and the cave’s interpretive area details the interesting history of the caves. Book your tickets for the Ngilgi Cave online here to discover more. Inclusions * Semi-guided tours depart every half hour at the Ngilgi Cave * Access to the interpretative centre onsite Time * Opening Hours is between 9am and 5pm daily * Semi-guided tours depart every half hour between 9:30am to 4:00pm * Closed Christmas Day Location * 76 Yallingup Caves Rd, Yallingup, WA, 6282. Just 10 minutes drive along Caves Rd from Dunsborough. What To Bring * Enclosed footwear suitable for climbing stairs is recommended * Bring hats and sunscreen in summer, waterproof jackets in winter * Camera (no tripods, camera stands or selfie-sticks) Additional Information * Enclosed footwear suitable for climbing stairs is recommended * Photography permitted but no tripods, camera stands or selfie-sticks * Arrival at the ticket counter 10 minutes prior to tour time is required. During busy holiday periods your place on the tour may be reallocated if you have not checked in 5 minutes prior to tour departure * Child age is 4-16 yrs. Children under 4 years old are not permitted on the tour Cancellation Policy * A full refund will be provided for cancellations received by close of business (5pm WST) on the day prior to the tour booking * In the event of ‘no shows’, or cancellations later than close of business (5pm WST) on the day prior to the booking, the operator may charge the full cost of the booked tour Booking Information * Confirmation in the form of a tour voucher will be received at time of booking * Upon completion of purchase, please print the voucher and present on day of the experience * Mobile Vouchers are accepted! - Vouchers can also be presented on your mobile device for this attraction * For your information, complete Tour Operator Information including contact details is included on your tour voucher * Availability was accurate at the time of booking however, is subject to change due to circumstances out of our control * We strongly suggest reconfirming your booking with the tour operator within 24 hours of making your booking and prior to making other travel arrangements

globaltix_product_data.summary: Sitting atop the 56-story megastructure, the SkyPark Observation Deck gives you a view of the best sites of Lion City unobstructed! Step into the building’s giant platform and easily spot landmarks such as the Singapore Flyer, Merlion Statue, and Esplanade, among others, through its clear glass rail...
globaltix_product_data.description: Sitting atop the 56-story megastructure, the SkyPark Observation Deck gives you a view of the best sites of Lion City unobstructed! Step into the building’s giant platform and easily spot landmarks such as the Singapore Flyer, Merlion Statue, and Esplanade, among others, through its clear glass railings. See Gardens by the Bay stand out from the rest of the city and the Spectra show lighting up the night from a 200-feet elevation. Afterwards, you can opt to dine at a rooftop restaurant while you enjoy the iconic sights.
highlights: Incredible views of Singapore
A fantastic place to have a drink and enjoy great city and bay garden views
Take in a bird’s-eye view of Gardens by the Bay and the impressive Supertree Grove, or spot Singapore's iconic landmarks from above.
inclusions: Admission Ticket for SkyPark Observation Deck
globaltix_product_data.termsAndConditions: Admission Tickets are valid for entry on the selected date and time only. Tickets are for single entry only. Entry is subject to availability and deck capacity (wait time may apply). Management reserves the right to reject entry for guests arriving after 4 PM. Opening hours may vary on certain dates. Please check the official website for closure dates before your visit. Only guests who have been on the Observation Deck for less than one (1) hour when it closes due to weather are entitled to a refund. No refund will be provided to guests denied entry or escorted out for non-compliance. Eligibility Adult Rate: Guests aged 13–59 years old. Concession Tickets: Applicable for Senior Citizens above 60 years old, students, children aged 2–12 years old, Persons with Disabilities (PWD), and NSF. Free Admission: Children below 2 years old. Everyone else must have a valid ticket for entry. Attraction Access The Observation Deck may be closed due to inclement weather (rain or lightning). Management reserves the right to close the deck as deemed necessary. Visitors typically spend 45 minutes to 1 hour on the deck. Magic Shot/Photo location: Queue Line @ Level B1 (SkyPark). Magic Shot is a GIF with animated background/effects added to the photo taken. Guests are not permitted to bring luggage onto the Observation Deck. Luggage may be checked at the Guest Services Desk (Porte Cochere, Tower 3) and is subject to security screening. Additional Information The SkyPark is wheelchair-accessible. Guests are advised to approach staff for assistance before entry. All guests may be subject to security checks, including bags and personal belongings, upon entry or exit. Guests must wear footwear at all times (bare feet are not permitted). Important Notes Throwing any items over the edge of the Observation Deck is strictly prohibited. Guests found violating rules may be removed and handed over to the Police. Loitering is not permitted. Guests who fail to comply with the rules may be denied entry or escorted out without refund. Admission is subject to the Conditions of Entry of Marina Bay Sands and the seller. Revised route to SkyPark Observation Deck: From Bayfront MRT, kindly exit B & take the escalator on the left to ground level 1. From ground level 1, turn right and walk along the outer side of the hotel from tower 1 to tower 3 – SkyPark Observation Deck. In case of rain, guests will need to access the Observation Deck via the following route: From Bayfront MRT, kindly exit C to Mall B2M Proceed to the end of the mall B2M (HUGO BOSS) From HUGO BOSS, take escalator on the right to Tower 3 – SkyPark Observation Deck. How to Get There Take the MRT to Bayfront Station (CE1/DT16) and follow the signs to Marina Bay Sands.
globaltix_product_data.address: 10 Bayfront Avenue, (Marina Bay Sands Hotel Tower 3)

options.name: Marina Bay Sands All Attraction Pass 1 [Sampan Rides, Digital Light Canvas, SkyPark Observation Deck (Non - Peak)]
options.description:
Sampan Rides

  • Location: The Shoppes, B2 - Nearest carpark: Central (Orange Zone)
  • Operating hours: Monday to Sunday: 11 AM - 9 PM (Last entry at 8.30 PM)
  • Please kindly inform our Customer Service for big groups (10 or more)
Digital Light Canvas

Operating Hours / Schedule

  • Open daily from 11:00 AM – 9:00 PM
  • Last entry: around 8:00 PM (subject to capacity)

Recommended arrival time:

  • Arrive 15–20 minutes before entry to allow for ticketing and queue (entry time is strictly observed).

Additional Notes / Tips

  • Best time to visit: Sunday–Thursday for fewer crowds; Friday evenings & Saturdays are peak periods
  • Interactive experience: The artwork reacts to your movement—walk around to fully enjoy it
  • Safety note: Floor can be slippery; move carefully
  • Visual sensitivity: Fast-moving lights and visuals may affect sensitive visitors

SkyPark Observation Deck

Experience breathtaking panoramic views of Singapore from the iconic SkyPark Observation Deck, perched atop the Marina Bay Sands. Enjoy stunning vistas of the city skyline, Gardens by the Bay, and the surrounding sea.

  • Permanent change to the access point for the SkyPark Observation Deck at Marina Bay Sands. Effective immediately, all guests will need to use the outer side of Hotel Towers 1, 2, and 3 to reach the Observation Deck entrance.
  • With immediate effect, the drop-off station for tour group will be strictly located at the MICE Sands and Expo Convention Center. After dropping off, all guests must use the exterior footpath of the hotel to reach the SkyPark Observation Deck entrance.
options.termsAndConditions:
Please click the "Manage Booking" link at the top of your e-ticket PDF to reserve your SkyPark Observation Deck, Digital Light Canvas and retrieve the ticket.

Sampan Rides

  • This ticket entitles one person to one Sampan Ride.
  • A valid ticket is required for all individuals, ie, children and all adults, including all adults accompanying young visitors and/or children.
  • For the safety and security of young visitors, children below the age of 13 must be accompanied by an adult (above the age of 18) at all times. The accompanying adult shall be required to purchase a valid entry ticket.
  • Proof of age may be required before entry is granted.
  • Children under 85cm in height are not permitted on the sampan.
  • For safety purposes, pregnant ladies are not allowed to take the ride.
  • Guests must remain seated for the duration of the ride.
  • Each ride can take up to six guests per boat; guests may be required to share a boat.
  • The Ticket holder assumes all risk and liability for any medical conditions associated with taking a Sampan Ride. MBS shall bear no liability for any personal injuries, health problems, or death sustained during a Sampan Ride directly or indirectly resulting from any existing medical condition of the ticket holder.
  • Entry to Marina Bay Sands Sampan Ride is subject to availability.
  • Last boat ride for the day will be at 8.50 pm.
  • All guests must comply with the rules and regulations for the Sampan ride.
  • The right of admission is reserved and is subject to the Conditions of Entry of Marina Bay Sands and its representatives. Guests who do not abide by the rules may be denied entry to or escorted out of the premises. Whenever a guest is not permitted to enter the premises or is escorted out for any reason stated in these conditions, no refund will be paid in respect of the ticket.
  • To view the latest Conditions of Entry & Terms and Conditions, please click here.

Digital Light Canvas

  • Only children below the age of 2 may enter without a ticket.
  • A valid ticket is required for all other individuals, ie. children above the age of 2 and all adults, including all adults accompanying young visitors and/or children (whether above or below the age of 2).
  • For the safety and security of young visitors, children below the age of 13 must be accompanied by an adult (above the age of 18).
  • The accompanying adult shall be required to purchase a valid ticket for entry.
  • Proof of age may be required before entry is granted.

 

SkyPark Observation Deck

Admission

  • Tickets are valid for entry on the selected date and time only.

  • For the safety of all of our guests, team members and marine animals, Resorts World Sentosa will be conducting bag checks on all personal and/or hand carry baggage.
  • Failure to follow posted guidelines may result in serious injury or expulsion from the attraction.

SkyPark Observation Deck at Marina Bay Sands (Peak)

  • Sands SkyPark Observation Deck is subject to inclement weather. If rain or lightning is present, then the SkyPark Observation Deck may be closed.
  • Only guests that have been up to the SkyPark Observation Deck for less than one (1) hour when it is closed are entitled to a refund. Management reserves the right to close the SkyPark Observation Deck as they deem necessary.
  • Entry to the SkyPark Observation Deck is subject to availability - wait time to enter will be based upon Observation Deck capacity.
  • Tickets are for single entry only.
  • Everyone else must have a ticket for admittance.

  • Adult rate applies to guests aged between 13-64 years old.
  • Only children below 2 years of age may enter without a ticket.
  • All guests may be subject to a search, including bags, clothes and other possessions when entering the SkyPark Observation Deck.
  • Searches may be conducted on the guests on the premises or when they are leaving it.
  • Throwing any item over the edge of the SkyPark Observation Deck is strictly prohibited.
  • Any guest found contravening this condition will be subject to immediate removal from the premises and may be handed over to the Police.
  • Guests are not permitted to take luggage up to the SkyPark Observation Deck.
  • Luggage may be checked with the Guest Services Desk located at the Porte Cochere of Tower 3. Checked luggage will be subject to physical or electronic security screening.
  • Guests who do not abide by the above rules may be denied entry to or escorted out of the premises.
  • Whenever a guest is not permitted to enter the premises or when a guest is escorted out for any reason stated in these conditions, no refund will be paid in respect of the ticket.
  • Guests must wear footwear – bare feet are not permitted.
  • Loitering on the SkyPark Observation Deck is not permitted. The right of admission is reserved and is subject to both the Conditions of Entry of Marina Bay Sands and of the seller.

Go to the website that is listed on the Claim Card and enter the necessary information. Remember to claim your photos as soon as possible. Photos only remain on the site for a short time
  • For more details on how to redeem your digital photo and ‘Magic Shots’ file you can visit this link https://www.mbsmoments.com/ContentPage/Help?PageName=Helpnewuser&LanguageID=1033

globaltix_product_data.description: Sitting atop the 56-story megastructure, the SkyPark Observation Deck gives you a view of the best sites of Lion City unobstructed! Step into the building’s giant platform and easily spot landmarks such as the Singapore Flyer, Merlion Statue, and Esplanade, among others, through its clear glass railings. See Gardens by the Bay stand out from the rest of the city and the Spectra show lighting up the night from a 200-feet elevation. Afterwards, you can opt to dine at a rooftop restaurant while you enjoy the iconic sights.
highlights: Incredible views of Singapore
A fantastic place to have a drink and enjoy great city and bay garden views
Take in a bird’s-eye view of Gardens by the Bay and the impressive Supertree Grove, or spot Singapore's iconic landmarks from above.

options.termsAndConditions:

  • A valid ticket is required for all individuals, ie, children and all adults, including all adults accompanying young visitors and/or children.

  • For safety purposes, pregnant ladies are not allowed to take the ride.

  • The Ticket holder assumes all risk and liability for any medical conditions associated with taking a Sampan Ride. MBS shall bear no liability for any personal injuries, health problems, or death sustained during a Sampan Ride directly or indirectly resulting from any existing medical condition of the ticket holder.
  • Entry to Marina Bay Sands Sampan Ride is subject to availability.

Guests who do not abide by the rules may be denied entry to or escorted out of the premises. Whenever a guest is not permitted to enter the premises or is escorted out for any reason stated in these conditions, no refund will be paid in respect of the ticket.

Digital Light Canvas

  • Only children below the age of 2 may enter without a ticket.

  • The accompanying adult shall be required to purchase a valid ticket for entry.
  • Proof of age may be required before entry is granted.

 

SkyPark Observation Deck

Admission

  • Tickets are valid for entry on the selected date and time only.
  • Tickets are for single entry only.
  • Entry is subject to availability and deck capacity (wait time may apply).
  • Management reserves the right to reject entry for guests arriving after 4 PM.
  • Opening hours may vary on certain dates. Please check the official website for closure dates before your visit.

  • No refund will be provided to guests denied entry or escorted out for non-compliance.

Eligibility

  • Adult Rate: Guests aged 13–59 years old.
  • Concession Tickets: Applicable for Senior Citizens above 60 years old, students, children aged 2–12 years old, Persons with Disabilities (PWD), and NSF.
  • Free Admission: Children below 2 years old.
  • Everyone else must have a valid ticket for entry.

globaltix_product_data.description: Time to dive in! Get close to animals in Antarctica, experience all kinds of other water-based encounters at one of Nice's best attractions! Take the kids to Marineland and experience everything from polar bears and sharks, dolphins and, killer whale shows and much more!If heaven were a French theme park in Nice it would probably look a lot like Marineland.There are sharks, penguins, and polar bears a-plenty. Don't worry, they're kept safely apart, but you can still visit them all in the . Whether you're charmed by goofy sea lions or amazed by killer whales, there's a show for you at Marineland. Trainers guide dolphins through impossible leaps and help sea lions put on comedy shows. But the real show stopper comes in the form of the killer whale show, where these fearsome creatures change from deadly hunters to bright people pleasers, getting their bellies scratched by trainers and jumping out of the water to impress kids and adults alike. Need a break in between shows? Watch the active sea lions, get up close to the polar bears penguins in Antarctica, watch the sharks through the and peruse and cruise the aquariums - this is you getting up close and personal to the life aquatic!

Watch carefully choreographed shows with California sea lions, fun-loving dolphins and orcas
See everything from sharks to flamingos, and head to Antarctica to see the royal penguins
