globaltix_product_data.description: At the heart of every child is a desire to play, explore and learn about the world around them. Tapping on this ingrained desire, The Little Things takes it up a notch by giving children a designated time and space for them to do just that. Along with our trained facilitators, children take on a real kitchen, complete with real tasks. In our weekly programmes, children take on a variety of experiences and challenges such as meal-planning, food preparation (from the market to the table!), food cultures, etiquette, presentations, and our termly Community Involvement projects! As a start to your child’s development, we will cultivate intangible and essential life skills such as independence, decision-making, teamwork, spatial awareness, resourcefulness and a thirst for knowledge – through an experiential journey with food. It’s all part of being Self-Savvy!
highlights: The Little Things provides children with hands-on experiences in a real kitchen environment to play, explore, and learn about the world.
Guided by skilled facilitators, children engage in meal-planning, food preparation, cultural exploration, and community projects, fostering independence.
Weekly activities cover food culture, etiquette, and community involvement, offering a holistic learning experience.
Through cooking, children develop teamwork, spatial awareness, resourcefulness, and a thirst for knowledge, laying the foundation for lifelong learning.
The Little Things empowers children by nurturing culinary and essential life skills, fostering self-sufficiency crucial for their development.

globaltix_product_data.description: Discover with expert historians and archaeologists one of the greatest jewels in Cordoba, where Abd Al-Rahman III the first Umayyad caliph ordered its construction and moved his court. It is an essential guided tour for knowing not only the Caliphate art but also the importance of Al-Andalus as an economic, social and cultural power in present-day society. You can enjoy a complete guided tour to the settlement and then to interpretation center that holds a unique collection of ancient objects recovered from the facilities. Your experience includes ticket and monolingual guided visit to medina azahara and the interpretation center, transportation. Everything is arranged so you can simply relax and enjoy the journey.

Located on Sentosa Island, the park features attractions like the iconic MegaZip, a 450-meter zipline that soars above the jungle canopy, the MegaClimb high ropes adventure, and the MegaJump free-fall simulator. Whether you're seeking a heart-pumping adventure or a fun family outing, Mega Adventure guarantees a day filled with excitement.
highlights: MegaZip: Soar 450 meters at speeds up to 60 km/h from the jungle canopy to Siloso Beach.
MegaClimb: Test your agility on a high ropes course with various levels of difficulty.
MegaJump: Experience the thrill of a free-fall jump from a 15-meter platform.
Stunning Views: Enjoy panoramic views of Sentosa Island and the South China Sea.
Perfect for Everyone: Suitable for adventure seekers, families, and team-building events.

globaltix_product_data.name: SUMMIT One Vanderbilt
globaltix_product_data.summary: SUMMIT One Vanderbilt is New York City's most immersive, visually breathtaking, and creatively extraordinary sky experience — a multi-sensory observation and art installation destination occupying the top four floors of One Vanderbilt Avenue, Midtown Manhattan's most striking supertall skyscraper, t...
globaltix_product_data.description: SUMMIT One Vanderbilt is New York City's most immersive, visually breathtaking, and creatively extraordinary sky experience — a multi-sensory observation and art installation destination occupying the top four floors of One Vanderbilt Avenue, Midtown Manhattan's most striking supertall skyscraper, that redefines what an observation experience can be through a spectacular combination of glass-enclosed outdoor terraces, indoor mirror and glass immersive art environments, and the most dramatic and unobstructed panoramic views of the New York City skyline available from any publicly accessible point in the world's most iconic urban landscape. Unlike any conventional observation deck, SUMMIT One Vanderbilt is as much a world-class contemporary art experience as it is an elevated viewing destination — the immersive installations of artist Kenzo Digital transforming the space into a sensory environment of extraordinary reflective beauty that multiplies and reframes the Manhattan skyline in endlessly surprising and visually arresting ways. The experience encompasses three distinct and equally extraordinary environments — the indoor glass and mirror immersive art spaces where the city and the sky are reflected and distorted into a visual world of almost infinite depth and beauty, the outdoor glass-enclosed terraces where the Midtown skyline fills every panel of the wraparound glazed walls at dazzling proximity, and the signature LEVITATION experience — glass-floored and glass-walled outdoor pods that extend beyond the building's facade at 1,000 feet above street level, placing guests in suspended transparent glass enclosures with the city visible in every direction including directly below their feet in a physical sensation of vertiginous aerial exposure that is completely unlike anything available at any other observation experience in New York City.

Stiletto heels, steel-toe boots, sneakers, and other footwear that may damage the mirrored floor are not allowed. Dress appropriately and avoid unnecessary exposure on glass and mirrored floors. SUMMIT recommends wearing long pants, shorts, or leggings whenever possible. If visiting during the day, SUMMIT recommends bringing sunglasses. Please note that all SUMMIT admission tickets are time-stamped. You must arrive at the specified time. Purchase your tickets to Mogo Wildlife Park here to see an array of Zebras, Rhinos and Giraffes all roaming together in the Savannah Plains. A taste of Madagascar can be found right here in Australia. Come visit the wildlife park to learn more about the fascinating animals firsthand during an informative animal keeper talk included in your Mogo Wildlife Park general admission ticket. Mogo Wildlife Park is a great value day out for families and travellers with an onsite cafe and a very special giraffe feeding experience available for an additional cost at the park.

globaltix_product_data.description: Make your Dubai vacation as adventurous and fun-filled as possible with our diverse Dubai Parks and Resorts™ passes! Select our Single Day Passes or Multi-Day Pass; each of them offers a variety of flexible options (See our ‘Inclusions’ section for more details). Credited to be the first Integrated Resort in the region, Dubai Parks and Resorts™ has two theme parks, one water park, a Polynesian-themed family resort, and a dedicated retail and dining section, in its colossal 16 million square feet site. Riverland, with a host of leisure, dining and retail choices, serves as the gateway to this resort. With four themed areas including Boardwalk, French Village, the Peninsula and India Gate, it lets visitors step back in time and also revel in several festivals as well as concerts. Motiongate Dubai: This theme park is inspired by Hollywood and features rides, attractions, and entertainment experiences based on popular movies and characters. It brings together three major film studios: DreamWorks Animation, Lionsgate, and Columbia Pictures. Visitors can immerse themselves in the worlds of movies like Shrek, Kung Fu Panda, The Hunger Games, Ghostbusters, and more. Legoland Dubai: Designed specifically for families with children aged 2-12, Legoland Dubai is a park where imagination comes to life. It features a variety of Lego-themed rides, attractions, and building experiences. Children can enjoy driving their own cars, piloting planes, embarking on thrilling adventures, and exploring miniature Lego cities. The park encourages creativity, learning, and fun for kids and their families. Legoland Water Park: Located adjacent to Legoland Dubai, Legoland Water Park is a refreshing water-themed attraction. It offers a combination of exhilarating water slides, splash pools, wave pools, and interactive play areas. Visitors can enjoy the wave pool, float along lazy rivers, build their own Lego rafts, and have a splashing good time. Real Madrid World (RMW): Real Madrid World is the first-ever theme park dedicated to Real Madrid, offering over 40 exciting rides and attractions. Divided into three zones – Champions Avenue, Celebration Plaza, and Stars Avenue – it celebrates the legacy of the world's greatest football club. From the thrilling Hala Madrid Coaster to the immersive Bernabéu Experience, there's something for every fan. Don't miss out on the chance to personalize your very own Real Madrid jersey at our official merchandise store. Welcome to the ultimate destination for families, fans, and theme park enthusiasts alike!
highlights: LEGOLAND® Dubai ensure that there is never dull moment for families with kids from 2 to 12 years.
At MOTIONGATE™ Dubai, take to all rides, games and shows inspired by Hollywood movies.
Smooth entry to region’s largest and one-of-its-kind integrated leisure attraction.
LEGOLAND® Dubai is the first LEGOLAND Park in the Middle East, with six zones such as FACTORY, IMAGINATION, LEGO® CITY, ADVENTURE, KINGDOMS and MINILAND.
Enjoy access to two of your favorite theme parks in the Dubai Parks and Resorts™, which is home to altogether two parks: MOTIONGATE™ Dubai, LEGOLAND® Dubai.

globaltix_product_data.description: Mozarthaus Vienna showcases the life and work of one of the world's most famous musical geniuses! Wander three exhibition levels spread across his old home, witness some of his creative achievements, and get a feel for the way he lived his life in 16th-century Vienna.Explore the only preserved apartment of his in Vienna over three levels, each offering different exhibitions about his life and work. Mozart lived in this elegant house from 1784 to 1787 and composed more of his music here than anywhere else. You'll tour four large rooms, two small ones, and a kitchen. You'll no doubt imagine Mozart with his wig and frilly-collar-wearing family in each one. With your free audio guide, you'll also hear some of his most important works. Even if you think you don't know much of his music, we bet you'll recognize a lot! The years Mozart spent in Vienna are considered the peak of his creative achievements. This is a must-see not just for Mozart fans, but for all music fans. He's one of the greats. Go visit him at home.

Get a real feel of the times the famous composer lived in and see where he wrote his world-famous opera The Marriage of Figaro and three of the six Haydn Quarte
Gain special insights with a free audio guide and see annual changing exhibitions

globaltix_product_data.description: The Museo Reina Sofía is Spain's foremost museum of modern and contemporary art and one of the most important cultural institutions in Europe. Its permanent collection traces the development of Spanish and international art across the 20th century, with Pablo Picasso's monumental anti-war painting Guernica serving as its undisputed centrepiece. This skip-the-line ticket combined with an expert guided tour ensures you experience the museum's defining works with the context and insight they deserve.
highlights: Skip-the-line access to the Reina Sofía, Spain's national museum of 20th-century and contemporary art
Expert guided tour including Picasso's Guernica — the museum's most iconic and historically significant work
Comprehensive collection spanning Spanish modernism, Surrealism, and the avant-garde
Works by Salvador Dalí, Joan Miró, and Juan Gris alongside Picasso's towering masterpiece
Housed in a beautifully converted 18th-century hospital with a striking modern glass tower extension by Jean Nouvel

globaltix_product_data.summary: Discover the Prado Museum on a guided tour accompanied by an expert guide. Choose from two start times: at 10.30 am for a regular tour or at 11:30 am for a small group, ideal for a more personalized experience. For approximately 1 hour and 30 minutes, you will explore a selection of the most iconic...
globaltix_product_data.description: Discover the Prado Museum on a guided tour accompanied by an expert guide. Choose from two start times: at 10.30 am for a regular tour or at 11:30 am for a small group, ideal for a more personalized experience. For approximately 1 hour and 30 minutes, you will explore a selection of the most iconic works, with explanations to help you understand their context and significance. You will admire iconic paintings by Velázquez, Goya, El Bosco and Rubens. If you choose the small group option, you can complete your experience by adding additional activities to suit your interests. Enjoy an e-bike tour of Retiro Park, a comfortable and fun way to explore this iconic part of the city, with stops at its main attractions so you can enjoy the views and take photos. You can also choose a tapas tasting at a nearby local tavern, where you will taste four typical Spanish tapas accompanied by a drink in a unique setting. If you prefer, you can combine both experiences and enjoy a complete package that brings together culture, cuisine and outdoor leisure. Itinerary: - Guided tour of the Prado / Prado + tapas: Departure at 10.30 am (regular group) or 11.30 am (small group) from the Goya Monument (Calle Felipe IV). The tapas option takes place after the tour, accompanied by the guide. - Retiro E-Bike + Prado / Retiro E-Bike + Prado + Tapas: Departure at 10.00 am

Create lasting memories at some of the region's most celebrated sights
Enjoy a well-organised itinerary that makes the most of your time
View world-class masterpieces at the Prado Museum
Discover one of Spain's most iconic experiences with an expert local guide

globaltix_product_data.description: Dubai is a land of marvels and one cannot get enough of it. While the tallest building, the largest mall and the largest indoor theme park, amongst other things, would keep you hooked to this marvelous city, the Museum of future, a recent addition, would surely leave you spellbound. The Museum of the future is as unique as it sounds and offers the visitors extraordinary sensory and visual experiences while being educational. The best part about this place is that unlike other museums, you do not have to be cautious about what you touch. On the other hand, this is an interactive museum and the more you touch and engage with the exhibits, the more fun you would have.
highlights: Futuristic Exhibits – Explore cutting-edge innovations in space, AI, robotics, and sustainability.
Fully Interactive Experience – Unlike traditional museums, touching and engaging with exhibits is encouraged.
Immersive Sensory & Visual Displays – Experience holograms, VR, and AI-driven simulations.
Architectural Marvel – Admire the stunning torus-shaped design covered in Arabic calligraphy.
Educational & Thought-Provoking – Discover visionary concepts shaping the future of humanity.

globaltix_product_data.summary: Paris's Army Museum (Musée de l'Armée) is one of the three largest arms museums in the world, and home to one of the biggest military history and art collections on the planet. None other than Napoleon Bonaparte has been resting here since 1861, in his tomb. Get priority entrance into this military-...
globaltix_product_data.description: Paris's Army Museum (Musée de l'Armée) is one of the three largest arms museums in the world, and home to one of the biggest military history and art collections on the planet. None other than Napoleon Bonaparte has been resting here since 1861, in his tomb. Get priority entrance into this military-minded collection of arms, armor, and art.The Artillery Museum has a vast collection of artillery pieces collected during the Revolution. Pose beside a cannon for a selfie and imagine Napoleon doing the same. Well, he would've, if he could've - he was known for being a bit vain.The , which contains Napoleon I's tomb, was built between 1677 and 1706 and its 110-meter golden dome stretches up into the Paris skies. His son and brothers rest here too, and the laurel crown and inscriptions represent the Empire's greatest victories.In the Old Department you'll see armor and weapons from the 13th to the 17th century. Items related to major figures of French history, from Francis I to Louis XIII, will help you imagine what it might have been like to be at war during those times. Likewise, in the Modern Department, revisit the bloodiest battles, snoop inside the life of soldiers and see how technologies have changed throughout the years. Get priority entrance to one of Paris's most popular museums, and get a front-row seat for some of history's bloodiest encounters.
highlights: See Napoleon's tomb in the impressive Dôme des Invalides and learn what weapons were used in each of the many wars
Relive the political, military, social and industrial history of France with several exhibitions in various themed rooms
Get priority entrance to one of the 5 most visited museums in France, with over 1.4 million visitors in 2015
inclusions: Discounted Night Entry, if selected (see additional info)

globaltix_product_data.description: The My Son site is located more than 40 kilometers west of Hoi An. It is the largest religious site in the ancient Champa kingdom in Vietnam, and is known as "Vietnam's Angkor Wat". The Cham people built Hindu temples here as early as the fourth century. In the centuries that followed, the Cham people continued to expand, making it the religious land of the Cham kingdom. It is one of the oldest ruins in Southeast Asia. It was not destroyed by the Nguyen Dynasty in Vietnam until the end of the seventeenth century with the decline of the Champa Kingdom, so it was gradually abandoned. At the beginning of the twentieth century, Western archaeologists came to study the history of the Cham ethnic group, so it was protected and included in the World Heritage List. The site is built in a lush valley surrounded by mountains. About 70 Hindu temples have been built in the whole valley. The Champa's pagoda is built with red bricks. Although it is not tall, it is complex in style, reflecting the Hindu style. It is also because compared with the giant city built with boulders - Angkor Temple in Cambodia, it can't stand the test of wind and rain. It is more corroded and damaged, and some places are overgrown with weeds; Also the more, some of the carvings are better preserved.
highlights: Built by the Champa Kingdom as early as the 4th century.
Surrounded by jungle and mountains, offering a serene natural backdrop.
One of Southeast Asia’s oldest and most important archaeological sites.

globaltix_product_data.name: National Archaeological Museum of Naples: Guided Tour
globaltix_product_data.summary: The mighty Hercules was far too busy for long queues. So why should you be any different? Grab a ticket to the National Archaeological Museum of Naples, and discover a treasure trove of ancient wonders that would make Pandora's Box jealous! See glorious statues and frescoes from antiquity depicting...
globaltix_product_data.description: The mighty Hercules was far too busy for long queues. So why should you be any different? Grab a ticket to the National Archaeological Museum of Naples, and discover a treasure trove of ancient wonders that would make Pandora's Box jealous! See glorious statues and frescoes from antiquity depicting mythical heroes and legends, marvel at mosaics, bronze and glasswork, and see ceramics and engraved copper from Pompeii, classical Greece, Egypt, Rome, and more.With this ticket, you'll also receive a free code to use in the Pemcards app. So, if you see something you love inside the National Archaeological Museum of Naples, snap a selfie with it and you can create a postcard that will be sent to your friends and family so they enjoy a snippet of your holiday as more than just a picture sent via text.Visit the museum's macabre centerpiece, the iconic Toro Farnese (Farnese Bull). It's the oldest single sculpture ever recovered from antiquity, depicting the myth of Dirce, who was tied to the horns of a bull by her brothers as a cruel form of punishment.Strike a pose with the muscle-bound Farnese Hercules flexing his demi-god bod, and spare a thought for poor old Atlas holding the weight of the world on his shoulders.The Farnese Atlas is the oldest extant statue of the great titan, and the oldest known representation of the celestial sphere in existence, so it's a unique piece of human history you will not want to miss.Peruse a magnificent collection of carbonized artifacts from Pompeii, relics and epigraphs from ancient Egypt, Rome, and lot more.
highlights: Browse the extensive collection of artifacts from Pompeii and Rome, plus relics and epigraphs from ancient Egypt
Marvel at the colossal and historical Toro Farnese (the Farnese Bull), Farnese Atlas, and Hercules statues
Get access to one of the world's most important collections of classical artifacts from antiquity
inclusions: Priority ticket to the National Archaeological Museum of Naples

globaltix_product_data.summary: The mighty Hercules was far too busy for long queues. So why should you be any different? Grab a ticket to the National Archaeological Museum of Naples, and discover a treasure trove of ancient wonders that would make Pandora's Box jealous! See glorious statues and frescoes from antiquity depicting...
globaltix_product_data.description: The mighty Hercules was far too busy for long queues. So why should you be any different? Grab a ticket to the National Archaeological Museum of Naples, and discover a treasure trove of ancient wonders that would make Pandora's Box jealous! See glorious statues and frescoes from antiquity depicting mythical heroes and legends, marvel at mosaics, bronze and glasswork, and see ceramics and engraved copper from Pompeii, classical Greece, Egypt, Rome, and more.With this ticket, you'll also receive a free code to use in the Pemcards app. So, if you see something you love inside the National Archaeological Museum of Naples, snap a selfie with it and you can create a postcard that will be sent to your friends and family so they enjoy a snippet of your holiday as more than just a picture sent via text.Visit the museum's macabre centerpiece, the iconic Toro Farnese (Farnese Bull). It's the oldest single sculpture ever recovered from antiquity, depicting the myth of Dirce, who was tied to the horns of a bull by her brothers as a cruel form of punishment.Strike a pose with the muscle-bound Farnese Hercules flexing his demi-god bod, and spare a thought for poor old Atlas holding the weight of the world on his shoulders.The Farnese Atlas is the oldest extant statue of the great titan, and the oldest known representation of the celestial sphere in existence, so it's a unique piece of human history you will not want to miss.Peruse a magnificent collection of carbonized artifacts from Pompeii, relics and epigraphs from ancient Egypt, Rome, and lot more.
highlights: Browse the extensive collection of artifacts from Pompeii and Rome, plus relics and epigraphs from ancient Egypt
Marvel at the colossal and historical Toro Farnese (the Farnese Bull), Farnese Atlas, and Hercules statues
Get access to one of the world's most important collections of classical artifacts from antiquity
inclusions: Priority ticket to the National Archaeological Museum of Naples

globaltix_product_data.description: National Gallery Singapore is a leading visual arts institution which oversees the world’s largest public collection of Singapore and Southeast Asian modern art. Situated at the birthplace of modern Singapore, in the heart of the Civic District, the Gallery is housed in two national monuments - City Hall and former Supreme Court - that have been beautifully restored and transformed into this exciting 64,000 square metres venue. Reflecting Singapore’s unique heritage and geographical location, the Gallery aims to be a progressive museum that creates dialogues between the art of Singapore, Southeast Asia and the world to foster and inspire a creative and inclusive society. This is reflected in our collaborative research, education, long-term and special exhibitions, and innovative programming. The Gallery also works with international museums such as Centre Pompidou, Musée d'Orsay, Tate Britain, National Museum of Modern Art, Tokyo (MOMAT) and National Museum of Modern and Contemporary Art, Korea (MMCA), to jointly present Southeast Asian art in the global context, positioning Singapore as a key node in the global visual arts scene.

globaltix_product_data.description: National Gallery Singapore is a leading visual arts institution which oversees the world’s largest public collection of Singapore and Southeast Asian modern art. Situated at the birthplace of modern Singapore, in the heart of the Civic District, the Gallery is housed in two national monuments - City Hall and former Supreme Court - that have been beautifully restored and transformed into this exciting 64,000 square metres venue. Reflecting Singapore’s unique heritage and geographical location, the Gallery aims to be a progressive museum that creates dialogues between the art of Singapore, Southeast Asia and the world to foster and inspire a creative and inclusive society. This is reflected in our collaborative research, education, long-term and special exhibitions, and innovative programming. The Gallery also works with international museums such as Centre Pompidou, Musée d'Orsay, Tate Britain, National Museum of Modern Art, Tokyo (MOMAT) and National Museum of Modern and Contemporary Art, Korea (MMCA), to jointly present Southeast Asian art in the global context, positioning Singapore as a key node in the global visual arts scene.

globaltix_product_data.description: Immerse yourself in the pre-Columbian history and culture of Mexico on this guided tour of the National Museum of Anthropology. Learn fascinating facts about the Aztec and Mayan civilizations as you admire ancient remains, stone statues, and reconstructed tombs. You will be visiting one of the most important buildings in Latin America, which houses rooms with pre-Hispanic evidence of the Mexicas, Mayas, Toltecs, and other ethnic cultures! Marvel at the colossal stone heads of the Olmec civilization, dating back to the Early Preclassic period. Enter the Mayan room to see a large collection of amazing murals, as well as a replica of the intricate lid from Pakal's tomb. Just down the hall, you'll discover a small-scale model of the ancient capital of Tenochtitlan, the area known today as Mexico City. Here you can also find the centerpiece of the museum's collection, the Aztec Stone of the Sun. Dating back to the 1400s, this calendar has been hailed by archaeologist Zelia Nullal as the "remarkable monument ever discovered on the American continent." globaltix_product_data.description: Science can be FUN! That's what you'll come away thinking after your trip to the Science Center Nemo, just minutes from Amsterdam's Centraal Station. This ginormous green building is the biggest science center in the Netherlands and home to 5 exciting floors of hands-on science stuff. Learn things like how and why the wind blows, what makes a rainbow, how to whisper to someone standing 15 feet away, and blow bubbles big enough to stand in. You'll wonder why you didn't find Nemo sooner.There are too many exhibitions inside to mention but you can't miss . We encounter physics every day, whenever there's a rainbow, or when our clean clothes throw off sparks. Here you can create phenomena like this yourself and learn how it works at the same time. In you can see a timeline of discoveries by scientists all over the world and journey through the Age of Enlightenment with old travel journals and atlases. In you'll learn what makes our brains tick - with the Emotion Grabber you can even add your facial expressions to a computer game! teaches how we can all save energy, produce our own electricity sustainably and reduce the amount of CO2 we send up into the atmosphere, and turns maths into a fun tool you can use (yes really).We could go on forever about this place, but we'll leave the rest for you to discover. Release your inner mad scientist and have fun!

globaltix_product_data.description: The impressive Neues Museum, located on Museum Island in Berlin, reopened its doors in 2009 after a big restoration, and marks the home of the 3,300-year-old bust of Egyptian queen Nefertiti - one of the most famous works of the ancient world. Get face-to-face with that ancient icon (and much, much more!). Step back into the ancient world with a visit to the Neues Museum. This recently restored building is rich in antiquities, curiosities, and mythology. Divide your time here between the two (equally fascinating) permanent exhibitions. (Egyptian Museum and Papyrus Collection) Ancient Egyptian and Nubian cultures abound in here. Lock eyes with the portrait heads of kings. Walk through three chambers of trinkets from the Old Kingdom. See the famous head of Tiye (one of the most influential women in ancient Egypt, believed to have lived from about 1398 BC – 1338 BC) and have your mind blown by the famous 3,300-year-old bust of Egyptian queen Nefertiti. (Museum for Pre- and Early History) Over 6,000 archaeological items represent life from the Stone Age through to the Middle Ages. See the Neanderthal from Le Moustier, gaze at wall paintings featuring Nordic mythology in the Odin, Urns and Looted Art room and witness the Berlin Gold Hat - a late Bronze Age headdress piece crafted from thin gold leaf, which originates from 1000-800 BC. You might not be walking like an Egyptian at the end of all this, but you'll definitely be able to talk like one. Getting there: Take any train, metro or bus to Friedrichstraße or a train or tram to Hackescher Markt.

The treasures of Egypt and art through the ages

globaltix_product_data.name: One World Observatory: Entry Ticket
globaltix_product_data.summary: Looking for the best views in town? We can do one better – how about the best views in the Western Hemisphere? The One World Trade Center stands proud as one of the tallest buildings in the world, and now you can soar straight to the top and enjoy breathtaking views of New York City and beyond with...
globaltix_product_data.description: Looking for the best views in town? We can do one better – how about the best views in the Western Hemisphere? The One World Trade Center stands proud as one of the tallest buildings in the world, and now you can soar straight to the top and enjoy breathtaking views of New York City and beyond with these skip-the-line One World Observatory tickets. Designed by master architect David Childs (of the Burj Khalifa in Dubai), the OWTC is a spectacular glass and steel monolith, reaching 1,776 feet into the sky. If you thought the outside was impressive, wait until you’re in. You'll be greeted with an exhibit detailing the tower's development, before being whisked into a custom LED screen-lined elevator. As you glide upwards, you'll be treated to a time-lapse history of New York – it's like you're flying through time! Of course, the real highlight of your One World Observatory tickets is waiting at the top. The three-story observatory offers unprecedented panoramic views of the world's greatest city. Your jaw might hit the ground, if it weren't so far away. Once your pulse has settled, check out the Sky Walk, which broadcasts real-time video onto the walls and floor, allowing you to get a real bird's-eye view of the city below. globaltix_product_data.description: Sun World Ba Na Hills is an entertainment complex in Da Nang, Vietnam, known for its breathtaking mountain scenery, French-inspired architecture, and world-class attractions. Visitors can ride one of the world’s longest cable cars, stroll across the famous Golden Bridge, explore the charming French Village, and enjoy thrilling games at Fantasy Park. With its cool climate, stunning landscapes, and diverse cultural experiences, Ba Na Hills is a must-visit destination for travelers seeking adventure and relaxation.
highlights: Enjoy the stunning panoramic views of the mountains and lush landscapes by the iconic "Hand of the Gods" bridge aka Golden Bridge.
Take one of the world's longest cable car rides, the cable car taking visitors through breathtaking mountain scenery.
Visit French Village - a charming European style village with cobblestone streets, Gothic architecture, and romantic atmosphere.
Visit Linh Ung Pagoda, a serene Buddhist temple featuring a giant white Buddha statue and peaceful surroundings.

Taking advantage of the spring holiday, come and set foot on Ma Wan Island with your family and friends.Hong Kong Noah's Ark, enter the poetic dream world and feel the wonderful nature. Noah's Ark in Hong Kong March 29 to 31, April 1,4,6,7, 2024 (Saturdays, Sundays and public holidays), bringing you special events"Hua Mei Qi Yuan". Let young people of all ages develop their artistic talent and creativity, participate in special D.I.Y. workshops, and handcraft a series of spring and flower-themed boutiques that will make your heart bloom and turn them into thoughtful gifts. including sweet and cute ones"A diffuser stone shaped like a cute bee and a little honey pot", and can add aromatherapy essential oil of your choice to exude happy energy at all times; you can also draw colorful"Flower Painted Cup", allowing the feeling of spring to accompany you leisurely every day; you can also cleverly combine creativity and STEAM knowledge to create "free-flying" animals on the spot."Fantasy Flying Butterfly", lifelike, triggering endless surprises! You can also participate during the trip"Natural Footprint Hunting Tour",Travel through many interesting check-in attractions in the park, collect different forms of commemorative seals step by step, and use your design talents to create fresh and timeless natural paintings. Active children can also have fun"Children's Fun and Speedy Fun"high trucks and"Cute Animal Riding Fun", galloping in the spring breeze. If you want to indulge in the Easter holiday more, you can sit in the restaurant of Noah's Ark Resort Hotel and taste the perfect ""Flower Language and Sea View Afternoon Tea"with a dazzling array of"Colorful Easter Seafood Buffet", feel the endless taste of spring! Better to stay in a hotel"Mushroom Forest Theme Room", the room is filled with fairy tale style, and you can indulge in a fresh and refreshing journey. *Each two tickets purchased will receive a set of 10 game tokens (applicable to participating in some activities), some activities require additional charges/need to meet specific participation conditions

options.termsAndConditions: Hong Kong Ma Wan Park Noah's Ark Pet Ticket Pet-friendly activity guidelines: On regular opening days, visitors are welcome to bring their pets into the theme park area. A corresponding adult/concession/pet admission ticket must be purchased for entry to visit the attractions and/or participate in certain activities. Each pet admission ticket allows entry for one dog or other pet only. Dogs or other pets visiting the park must be accompanied and supervised by a person aged 18 or above. Each person aged 18 or above may bring a maximum of two dogs or other pets. If the limit is exceeded, the purchased admission tickets cannot be transferred, exchanged, or refunded. As the park is also open to other visitors, fighting dogs/dogs classified as dangerous breeds/snakes/spiders/insects are not allowed entry. We appreciate your understanding. Fighting dogs include pit bull terriers, Japanese Tosas, Argentine Dogos, Brazilian Filas, or any mixed breeds involving fighting dogs. The park reserves the right to deny entry to any pets displaying aggressive behavior or tendencies. All dogs must be vaccinated against rabies, possess a valid dog license issued by the Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department, and be microchipped for identification. All dogs must have their microchips scanned upon entry and provide a copy or photo of their vaccination card for verification. All dogs must be fully vaccinated against common infectious diseases at least 14 days prior, including: Canine distemper, Canine parvovirus enteritis, and Other diseases requiring additional preventive measures as determined by the Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department Ma Wan is a 24-hour restricted vehicle zone. Private cars without a restricted area permit issued by the Transport Department are not allowed to enter. All participants please take note of the transportation arrangements. Pets are not allowed in any area of the restaurant. If needed, participants can bring their pets to designated outdoor/indoor leisure dining areas (pet-friendly meals require at least 3 days advance reservation). Each participant entering the venue and their accompanying pets must meet and comply with the relevant terms and conditions to gain entry and participate in the activity. For more detailed terms and conditions, please refer to the attached [Pet-Friendly Activity Guidelines]. "Large dogs" in public places must comply with the following control measures: "Large dogs must at all times be securely held on a leash not exceeding 2 meters in length..." All dogs must have their microchips scanned upon entry and provide a copy or photo of their vaccination card for verification. All dogs must be fully vaccinated against common infectious diseases at least 14 days prior, including: Canine distemper, Canine parvovirus enteritis, and Other diseases requiring additional preventive measures as determined by the Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department Ma Wan is a 24-hour restricted vehicle zone. Each participant entering the venue and their accompanying pets must meet and comply with the relevant terms and conditions to gain entry and participate in the activity. globaltix_product_data.description: Nong Nooch Tropical Garden Pattaya is a world-renowned botanical garden and cultural attraction located in Pattaya, Thailand. This expansive park features beautifully landscaped themed gardens, including French gardens, cactus collections, and tropical landscapes. Visitors can also enjoy traditional Thai cultural performances and unique attractions such as the dinosaur valley. It is an ideal destination for nature lovers, families, and photography enthusiasts. The recommended duration is approximately 2–4 hours or a half-day visit, depending on your pace and selected activities. The experience is self-paced, allowing guests to explore the gardens and attend shows at their convenience. Duration may vary depending on crowd levels, weather conditions, and show schedules. Guests can enter directly using a e-ticket or redeem tickets at the counter if required. Upon arrival, visitors can explore various themed garden zones, enjoy scenic walkways, and take photos at beautifully designed landscapes. Guests may also attend scheduled cultural shows and opt for a sightseeing tram ride for easier navigation. The visit offers a seamless combination of nature, culture, and leisure activities within one attraction.

globaltix_product_data.description: Okayama Castle was built by the daimyo Ukita Hideyoshi, who created the unification of the world for Toyotomi Hideyoshi. The castle tower is said to have been completed in 1597. The castle tower suffered from Zhu Rong during the war, and was rebuilt in Showa 41 (1966). It was selected as one of the top 100 famous castles in Japan. The outer wall is covered with black partitions, hence the name "Crow City", and "Golden Crow City" because of the use of "gold leaf tiles". The castle tower reopened in November 2022. In addition to the display of physical cultural relics, you can also experience various exhibitions with the theme of the Warring States and Edo period, take group photos, and explain the construction process of the castle town. We also recommend shops that sell limited original souvenirs, and you can enjoy sweets made with local ingredients in the cafe.
highlights: Explore Okayama Castle's rich history from the Toyotomi era.
Marvel at the iconic black exterior and "Golden Crow City" roof.
Experience interactive exhibitions on the Warring States and Edo periods.
Shop for unique souvenirs and savor local sweets at the cafe.

globaltix_product_data.description: Step into a world crafted for kids aged two to ten at the OliOli Children’s Museum Dubai! Two hours of endless delight and entertainment await your little ones here, boasting eight galleries spanning two levels and brimming with the most innovative displays. They are curated with the help of the most accomplished artists, educators, and phycologists worldwide. From themed fun highlighting air, water, and the future to creative segments for cars, it has something to delight every imagination.
highlights: A haven for kids of up to ten years to unleash their fancies and intellects, and a dynamic hub spot for adults to foster connections through hands-on experiences.
The dedicated toddler corner makes it a delightful and safe spot, even for the youngest guests.
Treat your little ones to two hours of immersive fun and entertainment at this one-of-a-kind OliOli Children's Museum.
Discover its two levels with eight zones and over 45 thrilling exhibits, offering insights from some of the world’s top artists, educators, developmental psychologists, and innovators.
Let your children embark on an exciting sensory adventure as they indulge in experiences themed around air, water, future, creativity, cars, and more.
globaltix_product_data.termsAndConditions: Tickets are valid for 2 hours only for the purchased timed session. Please arrive on time to maximize your visit. Late arrivals may miss out on the full 2-hour experience. ID proof is mandatory for each individual guest at the time of arrival. Children must be accompanied by an adult, and adults must be with a child to enter. The Toddler's Gallery is designed for kids aged 23 months and below, offering a safe environment. You can purchase toddler tickets directly at OliOli.  Shoe-free zones; socks available for purchase. Bring a change of clothes for water activities. Elevator and wheelchair-accessible facilities provided. Baby changing stations and nursing rooms are available. Animals are not allowed for hygiene and safety reasons. Our terms and conditions prohibit eating, drinking, and smoking inside the vehicle during any tour that includes transfer services.

The One World Trade Center stands proud as one of the tallest buildings in the world, and now you can soar straight to the top and enjoy breathtaking views of New York City and beyond with these skip-the-line One World Observatory tickets. Designed by master architect David Childs (of the Burj Khalifa in Dubai), the OWTC is a spectacular glass and steel monolith, reaching 1,776 feet into the sky. If you thought the outside was impressive, wait until you’re in. You'll be greeted with an exhibit detailing the tower's development, before being whisked into a custom LED screen-lined elevator. As you glide upwards, you'll be treated to a time-lapse history of New York – it's like you're flying through time! Of course, the real highlight of your One World Observatory tickets is waiting at the top. The three-story observatory offers unprecedented panoramic views of the world's greatest city. Your jaw might hit the ground, if it weren't so far away. Once your pulse has settled, check out the Sky Walk, which broadcasts real-time video onto the walls and floor, allowing you to get a real bird's-eye view of the city below. Take your sky-high experience to a whole new level with the One World Explorer Augmented Reality app. Grab one of the supplied iPads and take a virtual helicopter tour of the NYC skyline, or scan the horizon and see it brought to life with dynamic multimedia content

globaltix_product_data.description: Due to coronavirus, the In-Town Check-In service at Hong Kong and Kowloon stations will be suspended with effect from 10 April 2020. The Airport Express Shuttle Buses which runs between Hong Kong Station/Kowloon Station and major hotels as well as railway interchanges will also be suspended. The AEL train service during weekday peak hours will be maintained at an interval of 15 minutes, while the non-peak service will be adjusted to an interval of 30 minutes. In addition, starting from 10 April 2020, weekday non-peak services as well as services on Saturdays, Sundays and public holidays on the TCL and TML Phase 1 will be adjusted to an interval of around 10 minutes. Passengers may experience an extra waiting time of about one to two minutes on average. DRL service will be suspended starting from the same day while shuttle buses will be deployed to run between Sunny Bay and Disneyland Resort stations. A Hong Kong Airport Express Ticket is the fastest and most convenient way to get between Hong Kong Airport and the city! There’s no need to exchange tickets, just scan your QR code at the gate and hop on the train. You’ll also find free WiFi in every Hong Kong Airport Express carriage to pass the time, although with only 24 mins between stations, you won’t need it for long! Free In-town Check-in Service Make the journey even smoother with the Hong Kong Airport Express free in-town check-in service available for many major airlines at Hong Kong and Kowloon stations. You can check in and collect your boarding pass between 90 minutes and one full day ahead of your scheduled flight departure time. Simply scan your QR code to enter the check-in area.

Round-trip ticket QR Code The first journey must be used within the face validity period, and the second journey must be used within 30 days from the date of use of the first journey. globaltix_product_data.description: The ultimate in water-fuelled relaxation, visit Queenstown's Onsen Hot Pools and immerse yourself in pools overlooking the iconic Shotover River! Heal your body and mind with the soothing benefits of pure water all while surrounded by some wonderful scenery at this essential attraction featuring a range of exclusive pools indoors and outdoors that can accommodate up to four adults. This flexibility makes the pools ideal either for romantic getaways and pampering, or for a group of friends looking to take things in Queenstown down a notch and unwind in this magical part of New Zealand. Located within just a short 10 minute drive from the centre of Queenstown - and with a courtesy shuttle bus provided - it's an easily accessible and highly therapeutic attraction ideal for anyone looking to mend tired bones or bodies. Kick back in the hot waters, see the jet boats zip by in the Shotover Canyon below, and enjoy the ultimate in Queenstown relaxation - book yourself a session at the Onsen Hot Pools today. Please note one room can accommodate up to 4 people (e.g. 2 adults + 2 children, 3 adults + 1 child). If you have selected the "4 Adults" option, "Per Child" option cannot be added on. Known for its distinctive futuristic design and panoramic views, the tower offers visitors a unique perspective of Shanghai’s blend of modern architecture, historic dist...
globaltix_product_data.description: The Oriental Pearl Radio & Television Tower is one of Shanghai’s most iconic landmarks, rising above the city skyline in Lujiazui. Known for its distinctive futuristic design and panoramic views, the tower offers visitors a unique perspective of Shanghai’s blend of modern architecture, historic districts, and the Huangpu River.
highlights: Enjoy 360-degree panoramic views of Shanghai from multiple observation decks
Experience the Glass Floor Skywalk for a thrilling view straight down
Visit themed exhibitions showcasing Shanghai’s history and urban development
Capture stunning photos of Pudong and Puxi from one of Shanghai’s most famous viewpoints
globaltix_product_data.termsAndConditions: This is a time-slot admission ticket. Please arrive at the ticket check area on the right side of "Welcome to Shanghai" within your selected time slot. Late arrivals will not be accepted. (Example: For the 9:00 AM–11:00 AM time slot, ticket validation must be completed between 9:00 AM and 11:00 AM.) The Star Express Lane provides a fast track to reach the main observation deck at 263m when ascending the tower, significantly reducing queuing time. However, this does not mean you can skip the queue entirely. The actual situation is subject to the attraction's on-site conditions. Each adult can bring a maximum of 1 child (including free entry and child tickets). Unused bookings can be refunded within 1 year from the date of use, but cannot be refunded after 1 year. All visitors must provide real-name information when purchasing tickets. Please present your original ID card (People's Republic of China resident ID card) when entering the park. Your ID card will be used for ticket verification and gate access, and it must match the ID information provided during ticket purchase. Thank you for your understanding and cooperation. When purchasing tickets, the Oriental Pearl Radio & Television Tower in Shanghai requires your ID number, name, and contact information. The information you provide will be kept confidential. If you refuse to provide the required real-name information during ticket purchase or meet other conditions mentioned in the product details that prevent entry, you may be denied access. We will not use your information for any other purposes. Except as required by law or for government verification, we will not share, provide, or disclose any information you submit during ticket purchase. Valid only on the selected travel date and within the chosen time slot; expires after use. One-time use only - after taking the elevator down from the tower, re-entry is not permitted. globaltix_product_data.description: The Santa Maria Cruise is themed after Christopher Columbus's flagship, the Santa Maria, which reached the New World. It is twice the size and serves as a sightseeing cruise ship for exploring Osaka Port. Departing from Nishinagahama, the Tempozan Harbor Village and Kaiyukan offer a scenic tour of Osaka's harbor. Enjoy the sea breeze, forget the hustle and bustle of daily life, and savor leisurely moments. How to get there: From Kansai Airport, take the Airport Limousine Bus for approximately 60 mins (about 5 mins from the drop-off point). From Shin-Osaka Station, take the Midosuji Line to Honmachi for about 11 mins, then transfer to the Chuo Line from Honmachi to Osaka Port for about 11 mins. From Osaka Port, it is about a 10-minute walk.
highlights: The leisurely cruise around the Osaka Bay Area.

Please follow these steps to complete the verification. 1. Enter a valid email address and tap Send. 2. Check your email to see if you've received the OTP password email. If you can't find it, it may have been classified as spam. If it's not in your spam folder either, the email address you entered may be incorrect. Please reopen the website and enter your email address again. 3. Enter the OTP code from your email on the ticket screen and select Confirm. If the code is correct, you'll be directed to the e-ticket usage screen. Please note: Once OTP verification is complete, the email address cannot be changed. Therefore, please make sure to enter your own email address when verifying.

Therefore, please make sure to enter your own email address when verifying.

globaltix_product_data.summary: The tramcar is the largest rotating aerial cabin in the world, and it turns twice during the ascent, so the view moves steadily around you — the walls of Chino Canyon rising close on either side, the desert floor and the whole Coachella Valley falling away below. The climb covers nearly six thousand...
globaltix_product_data.description: The tramcar is the largest rotating aerial cabin in the world, and it turns twice during the ascent, so the view moves steadily around you — the walls of Chino Canyon rising close on either side, the desert floor and the whole Coachella Valley falling away below. The climb covers nearly six thousand vertical feet in about ten minutes, and it passes through several distinct ecological zones on the way. You board among creosote and palms in desert heat and step out at 8,516 feet into pine forest, thirty to forty degrees cooler, with snow on the ground for much of the year. At the top, Mountain Station has viewing decks, two restaurants, a small natural history museum and the trailheads for more than fifty miles of paths through Mount San Jacinto State Park. Even a short walk from the station puts you in silence among the trees.
globaltix_product_data.termsAndConditions: Wheelchair accessible Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller Service animals allowed Suitable for all physical fitness levels Please present voucher to the ticket office. Tickets will be timed for the next available tram car as a first come first serve basis. The Tramway is subject to delays and periodic shutdowns due to unforeseen circumstances and is not responsible for ticket refunds or the inability to redeem a voucher Tramway cars hold 80 people each and there are no seats. Passengers remain standing throughout the journey up the mountain Distance is approximately 12,800 feet, with a vertical ascent of 5,873 feet - 15 minutes travel time one way The tramway is known as a double reversible type of aerial tramway. Each car remains on one pair of track cables moving up and down without turning around. Each car serves as a counter balance to the other, the descending car is helping pull the ascending car up the mountain Strollers are permitted on this tour During holiday periods, you may experience long lines. We recommend you travel outside of these peak times to fully enjoy everything the tramway and mountain have to offer. There is parking in 13 paved lots near Valley Station. There is free shuttle service from parking lots to Valley Station entrance available weekends and holiday periods

globaltix_product_data.description: History unfolds at the grand Castel Sant'Angelo with a convenient skip-the-line ticket. Your guide will be waiting to lead you into this magnificent castle, with its fascinating past as a mausoleum, fortress, papal residence, and prison. Then you can browse at your leisure. Learn about the castle's secrets; how it was a creation of Roman Emperor Hadrian, intended as a serene resting place for his family and himself. Meander through resplendent chambers, adorned with ornate frescoes and detailed sculptures, each echoing the stories of long ago. See intricate details like the spiral ramp, leading right up to a rooftop terrace. From here, soak up the breathtaking panorama of Rome's dazzling skyline. Meeting Point: Meet the representative at the Castel Sant'Angelo, located in Lungotevere Castello, 50, right in front of the Castel, near the Angel Statue at one of the pick up time indicated Look for the activity provider's coordinators, who will be wearing purple t-shirts with the Crown Tours Logo They'll help you get your tickets easily so you can enjoy your visit

globaltix_product_data.name: Paradis Latin Show with Champagne
globaltix_product_data.summary: Witness a one-of-a-kind cabaret spectacle at the Paradis Latin and see the spectacular performances at the show. Indulge in delicious champagne as the artists perform incredible feats and the acrobats dazzle you with their aerial presence. If you only see one show in Paris, make it Le Paradis Latin...
globaltix_product_data.description: Witness a one-of-a-kind cabaret spectacle at the Paradis Latin and see the spectacular performances at the show. Indulge in delicious champagne as the artists perform incredible feats and the acrobats dazzle you with their aerial presence. If you only see one show in Paris, make it Le Paradis Latin Cabaret! Paradis Latin Show with Champagne Highlights Watch the latest show at Paradis Latin - "Paradis Ã la Folie" Experience the â€˜Cabaret of Choiceâ€™ as voted by the people of Paris Indulge in champagne as you witness the mesmerizing show play out in front of you. Choose from different ticket options and select the one the best suits you. Why Visit Paradis Latin The famous Parisian Cabaret is located in the heart of Paris, a few steps from Notre Dame and the Pantheon. Built by Gustave Eiffel in 1889 and listed as a historical heritage of the capital, Paradis Latin presents its show "Paradis Ã la Folie" and welcomes prestigious artists who are admired from around the world. Witness a fabulous cocktail show of catchy pictures, spectacular attractions, breathtaking French Cancan and much more! Your Paradis Latin Experience The Paradis Latin is an exotic French cabaret experience. Watch the cabaret transform into a magical garden where dancers take you on a farandole full of surprises, cheerfulness, enchanted rides, masked balls, and musicals. With breath-taking visuals the modern ballets in performed in the traditional style of the Parisian cabarets. The humorous script is enacted by an array of wide-ranging performers. The young and beautiful girls, the charming dancers, the jugglers and acrobats and a very Parisian presenter will make you spend a night of dreams at the Garden of Paradise. To know more about the venue, refer our detailed guide on Paradis Latin Ticket Options You will find these ticket options on the next page to choose from, allowing you to select the experience that best suits your needs. These variants exist for all the shows unless mentioned otherwise. Show with a glass of champagne Show with half-a-bottle of champagne Show with half-a-bottle of champagne and a platter of macarons
highlights: Brace yourself for an exotic French cabaret experience at one of the oldest and most historic cabaret venues in Paris, the Paradis Latin.
Enjoy a special show for Paradis Latin’s 130th anniversary, "L'Oiseau Paradis," with its themes of sensuality, poetry, emotion, humor, and new technologies.
Watch the cabaret transform into a magical garden where dancers take you on a farandole of surprises, enchanted rides, masked balls, and musicals!
Choose to pair your show tickets with either a glass of champagne or half a bottle of champagne to enhance your experience further.

globaltix_product_data.summary: An elegant and glass-lined boat traverses the waters of the Seine. Night has fallen and the twinkling lights show you why Paris is known as . The French waiter serves you fine French cuisine, and a glass of wine is just an arm’s length away. A singer performs standards in the background… Nope, this...
globaltix_product_data.description: An elegant and glass-lined boat traverses the waters of the Seine. Night has fallen and the twinkling lights show you why Paris is known as . The French waiter serves you fine French cuisine, and a glass of wine is just an arm’s length away. A singer performs standards in the background… Nope, this isn't an over-produced TV commercial; it's perhaps the most elegant way to see Paris.The cruise's beginning is picture-perfect: you hop aboard your vessel under the shadow of the Eiffel Tower. Then you cast off and heads southeast towards Île de la Cité and Notre Dame Cathderal, before looping along the other bank of the river. You’ll spend two and a half unhurried hours taking in Paris's sights from the water: the Louvre, Place de la Concorde, the Museé D’Orsay and many others. As you eat, drink, and be merry.You’ll be struck by just how elegant the boat is. Of course, it doesn’t hurt that they’ll give you a glass of champagne or wine (depending on which option you purchase) when you first come aboard. And then the music begins. A live singer accompanied by a small backing band will provide the soundtrack for your evening. Now you're in the mood!Dinner is a four-course gourmet meal, prepared by onboard chefs in a fully equipped kitchen and served by an attentive and discreet wait staff. Wine, , is served alongside your meal. This isn’t so much a boat, as an elegant, floating restaurant.Whether it’s a romantic dinner for two or a lively group meal, seeing Paris from the water, with its lights twinkling in the distance is . Choose the service and cuisine option that suits you, and get ready for a very memorable evening.a la carte

globaltix_product_data.name: Park Güell Guided Tour
globaltix_product_data.summary: Park Güell is one of Antoni Gaudí's most joyful, colourful, and imaginatively exuberant creations — a UNESCO World Heritage garden and public park on the Carmel hill of Barcelona that was originally conceived as a residential garden city for the Catalan bourgeoisie before being transformed into the...
globaltix_product_data.description: Park Güell is one of Antoni Gaudí's most joyful, colourful, and imaginatively exuberant creations — a UNESCO World Heritage garden and public park on the Carmel hill of Barcelona that was originally conceived as a residential garden city for the Catalan bourgeoisie before being transformed into the extraordinary public space that has become one of the city's most beloved and internationally recognised landmarks. The park's most celebrated features — the serpentine mosaic bench of the main terrace, the gingerbread gatehouses at the main entrance, the forest of inclined stone columns supporting the terrace above, and the spectacular views across Barcelona to the Mediterranean — are explored with expert guided commentary that reveals the artistic thinking and architectural innovation behind each extraordinary element. The Amigo Tours guide brings Gaudí's creative philosophy to life at every stop — explaining the trencadís mosaic technique of broken ceramic tile, the structural logic of the inclined columns, and the way Gaudí drew inspiration from natural forms, organic structures, and the colours of the Catalan landscape in creating a park that feels simultaneously ancient and entirely unlike anything ever built before. Pre-secured entry tickets eliminate the challenge of independent procurement for this popular UNESCO attraction.

Enjoy expert commentary from a professional licensed guide
Enjoy stunning views of Barcelona
Relax on the serpentine bench with panoramic views
Discover the colorful trencadís mosaics
Learn fascinating stories and secrets of Gaudí
Admire Gaudí’s masterpiece in a UNESCO World Heritage Site

globaltix_product_data.description: Parque Warner Beach is Madrid's most thrilling and comprehensively equipped water park — a spectacular summer leisure destination located within the Parque Warner Madrid resort complex in San Martín de la Vega, approximately 30 kilometres south of the Spanish capital. Spanning an expansive site of purpose-built water attractions, wave pools, lazy rivers, high-speed water slides, and dedicated children's play areas, Parque Warner Beach delivers one of the most complete and exhilarating aquatic entertainment experiences available anywhere in the Madrid region — combining the refreshing relief of world-class water attractions with the energy, excitement, and family-friendly entertainment that have made the broader Parque Warner resort one of Spain's most visited and beloved leisure destinations. The park's extensive range of attractions caters to every age group and thrill level — from the adrenaline-charged speed slides and multi-person raft rides that deliver the park's most intense aquatic experiences to the relaxed wave pool, lazy river, and children's splash zones that provide equally rewarding but more gently paced water leisure for families with younger guests. The Parque Warner Beach season typically runs from late spring through to early autumn — coinciding with Madrid's long and intensely sunny summer season that makes the park's water attractions a genuinely essential and deeply satisfying refuge from the heat. The park is easily accessible from Madrid by private vehicle or shuttle service and can be combined with a visit to the adjacent Parque Warner Madrid theme park for an extraordinary full day of dual entertainment.

globaltix_product_data.name: Pattaya Dolphinarium
globaltix_product_data.summary: Do you want to return to your childhood again and truly enjoy everything that is happening around you? Then the show at the dolphinarium is a great choice in order to have fun. Welcome to our unique marine mammal show! An exclusive program of performances of dolphins and seals and communication with...
globaltix_product_data.description: Do you want to return to your childhood again and truly enjoy everything that is happening around you? Then the show at the dolphinarium is a great choice in order to have fun. Welcome to our unique marine mammal show! An exclusive program of performances of dolphins and seals and communication with these amazing animals will charge you with positive emotions for many days to come. And it’s hard to describe how happy your children will be! Be sure to visit the show at the dolphinarium, and believe us – you will definitely come to us more than once!
highlights: World-Class Dolphin Show: Watch highly trained dolphins and seals perform acrobatics, jumps, and playful tricks in a lively indoor arena.
Close Animal Encounters: Upgrade your visit to swim or take photos with dolphins under the guidance of professional trainers.
Family-Friendly Attraction: Enjoy a fun and educational marine show suitable for visitors of all ages.
Modern Indoor Venue: Relax in a comfortable, climate-controlled theater with clear views of the performance pool.
Memorable Photo Moments: Capture unique moments with dolphins and seals after the show for a lasting travel memory.
inclusions: Standard Swimming : - Swim with dolphins, holding on to the dorsal and pectoral fins / dance with dolphins / get a kiss on the cheek from a dolphin.
globaltix_product_data.termsAndConditions: Admission Customers must use the service on the date specified on the ticket. If the service is used on a different date, customers will be required to purchase a new ticket onsite at the walk-in rate. Tickets are valid only for the selected date and time. The above rates are per person and inclusive of 7% VAT. Eligibility Child refers to guests whose height is between 80–120 cm, and the age must not exceed 12 years old. Children under 80 cm are considered infants and can enter free of charge under adult supervision, with no seat provided. Swimming with dolphins is permitted for adults and children aged 6 years and above. Children under 6 years old are not allowed to participate. The swimmer’s weight must not exceed 100 kilograms. For swimmers weighing 100 kilograms or more, the program may be provided with exceptions for certain parts of the activity. People with acute or chronic skin diseases, mental illnesses, cardiovascular diseases, sexually transmitted diseases, helminthiasis, other infectious diseases, those under the influence of drugs or alcohol, pregnant women, people with special needs, and those with infantile cerebral palsy are not allowed to swim with dolphins. Attraction Access Please make your booking at least 1 hour in advance before the service time. Show duration: 50 minutes per round. Swimming duration: 10 minutes per round. Additional Information The above rates are subject to availability. Customers who present a Child ticket but exceed 120 cm in height will be required to pay the price difference from Child to Adult at the Company’s selling rate before entering the show. Important Notes Free cancellation is allowed if cancelled at least 24 hours before the show time. Cancellations made less than 24 hours prior to the show time and No-Show cases will be charged 100% of the ticket price. “No-show” applies to the Agent’s customers who do not present themselves on time for the booked program and will be subject to a 100% cancellation charge to the Agent. Any cancellations or amendments must be notified to the Company in writing via email. Verbal notifications will not be accepted under any circumstances. Once tickets are issued, they are non-refundable and non-changeable. How to Get There By taxi or private car: Easily accessible by road from Pattaya city center. Public transportation options are limited; taxis are the most convenient way to reach the Dolphinarium.

globaltix_product_data.termsAndConditions: Wheelchair accessible Public transportation options are available nearby Transportation options are wheelchair accessible Suitable for all physical fitness levels For security measures, bags are not allowed at the Arizona Memorial but storage facilities are available at the Visitor Center for a nominal fee. Due to repair work beginning September 3 at the USS Arizona Memorial, boat service from the Pearl Harbor Visitor Center may only be confirmed the day prior or same day. As a result, no tour operator can guarantee access to the memorial during this period. The Pearl Harbor Visitor Center exhibits and theater will remain open, and our tour will continue to operate as scheduled. Should boat service be available, guests will be able to visit the memorial; however, access cannot be assured in advance. The Battleship Missouri will remain open throughout the construction. We apologize for any inconvenience and appreciate your understanding. We try our very best to keep to the itineraries, however, we ask for your understanding in route / schedule changes as there may be factors beyond our control. Wheelchair lift vehicle available upon request with 24 hours advance notice. At the Arizona Memorial: Wheelchair accessible. At the USS Missouri: Only the main deck is wheelchair accessible. Please dress casually and wear comfortable shoes for light walking. We also recommend you bring sunglasses and a camera. Please note: the National Parks Service permits us to provide 'wayfinding' only within the park sites. Unfortunately we are not permitted to provide any interpretation within the park.

Its permanent galleries feature exceptional objects from Peranakan material culture, complemented by a contemporary exh...
globaltix_product_data.description: The Peranakan Museum explores the culture of Peranakan communities in Southeast Asia and possesses one of the finest and most comprehensive public collections of Peranakan objects. Its permanent galleries feature exceptional objects from Peranakan material culture, complemented by a contemporary exhibition design. The museum spans three floors, exploring Peranakan life through themes related to origins, home, and style as aspects of identity. Community interviews, recorded demonstrations, art commissions, and other contemporary expressions of Peranakan culture provide a multi-faceted experience for visitors, encouraging them to ask themselves: ""what is Peranakan?""
highlights: Southeast Asia through thematic showcases, objects, interactive displays, and programmes.
The Peranakan Museum provides insights into the diverse Peranakan cultures of Singapore

Touching artefacts, paintings, or works is prohibited because oil from fingers will contaminate and eventually destroy the objects. Your safety is important to us. Please do not lean on showcases as they can break under pressure. Please do not run in the museum as this may cause our artefacts to be knocked over. Please eat or drink outside the museum. Our galleries need to be kept clean from food, spillage, and pests. Please refrain from bringing large backpacks, trolleys, or other bulky items into the galleries.

globaltix_product_data.description: Go City makes sightseeing flexible and stress-free. Get access to your choice of 3, 4, 5 or 7 top Philadelphia attractions, all on one digital pass. With more than 35 options to choose from, there's something for everyone - and there's 30 days validity so you don't have to rush around. Encounter marine life at Adventure Aquarium, tour the city with Big Bus Philadelphia, visit the historic Eastern State Penitentiary and meet exotic animals at Philadelphia Zoo - there's all this and more! What's included on the Philadelphia Pass? The Franklin Institute Adventure Aquarium Big Bus Philadelphia - Hop-On Hop-Off Tours Philadelphia Zoo Eastern State Penitentiary Philadelphia Museum of Art Longwood Gardens LEGOLAND® Discovery Center Philadelphia Museum of the American Revolution Academy of Natural Science Barnes Foundation Battleship New Jersey Museum & Memorial National Constitution Center Betsy Ross House Independence Seaport Museum How does a Philadelphia Explorer Pass work? Go City makes sightseeing flexible and hassle-free. Simply purchase a 3 to 7-attraction pass, use the Go City app to plan your itinerary, make reservations where needed and you're ready to get exploring! Your pass is valid for use over 30 days so there's plenty of time to discover the city at your own pace. Other attractions included on the Philadelphia Explorer Pass: African American Museum Brandywine Museum of Art Christ Church Burial Ground Dark Philly Adult Night Tour Ghost Tour of Philadelphia National Liberty Museum Otherworld Philadelphia Penn Museum Philadelphia Food & Cheesesteak Tour Philadelphia Movie & Television Tour Philadelphia Street Art Tour Philly Magic Tour Philly PHLASH Dowtown Loop 1 Day Pass Revolution and Founding Father's Tour Rodin Museum Solve A Mystery: The Kidnapping by Independence Hall South Philly Italian Market Tour True Crime Philadelphia and History Tour Wayvine Winery Kennett Square Tasting Experience Weitzman National Museum of American Jewish History *Savings based on itineraries on Go City website. Check the Go City app or digital guidebook for the most up-to-date list of attractions and reservations instructions: gocity.com/philadelphia/en-us/guidebook/explorer

Save up to 50% compared to buying individual tickets
Unused passes are valid for 1 years from the purchase date
Access to 3, 4, 5 or 7 attractions or tours
Popular things to do in Philadelphia including museums, a hop-on hop-off bus and themed walking tours

You are about to witness an unforgettable spectacle where bravery and mastery take your breath away. The show’s partic...
globaltix_product_data.description: Welcome to a world where every moment keeps you on the edge. This is not just a circus — this is a show where you will see speed, fire, and the incredible courage of the performers! You are about to witness an unforgettable spectacle where bravery and mastery take your breath away. The show’s participants defy gravity: the legendary “Wheel of Death” appears in the arena, motorcyclists rush inside the steel globe, and the master of knife throwing demonstrates precision that makes your heart stop. A blazing fire show will turn the performance into a true volcano of emotions. This show is more than a circus. It is energy, risk, and spectacle that you will never forget. Don’t miss it! Phuket Circus is the place where extreme acts and art merge into one powerful element. Come — and become part of the legend!
highlights: Discover a performance where energy, risk, and spectacle merge into one.
Breathtaking stunts, incredible dynamics, and a powerful atmosphere create a show you simply cannot look away from!
Whether you come with friends, family, or your significant other — this show will give you emotions that will stay with you forever!

This is not just a circus — this is a show where you will see speed, fire, and the incredible courage of the performers! You are about to witness an unforgettable spectacle where bravery and mastery take your breath away. The show’s participants defy gravity: the legendary “Wheel of Death” appears in the arena, motorcyclists rush inside the steel globe, and the master of knife throwing demonstrates precision that makes your heart stop. A blazing fire show will turn the performance into a true volcano of emotions. This show is more than a circus. It is energy, risk, and spectacle that you will never forget. Don’t miss it! Phuket Circus is the place where extreme acts and art merge into one powerful element. Come — and become part of the legend!

globaltix_product_data.description: Inspired by Thailand’s exotic heritage, Phuket FantaSea not only showcases the charm and beauty of Thailand, but also enriches ancient Thai traditions with the wonder of cutting-edge technology and special effects. The result is a stunning 30-acre cultural theme park that has become the ultimate in night-time entertainment on the resort island of Phuket. Created at a cost of over 3,500 million Baht (US$100 million), Phuket FantaSea offers a multitude of attractions not found anywhere else in the world.
highlights: Offers a unique entertainment experience that immerses guests in the rich heritage of Thailand.
Spectacular performances to cutting-edge special effects, Phuket FantaSea stands as the ultimate nighttime destination on the island.
Unforgettable journey into the heart of Thai culture and folklore.
globaltix_product_data.termsAndConditions: Admission Ticket is valid only on the selected date. For same-date visits, please purchase tickets before 8:00 PM. Booking must be made at least 1 day in advance. Rates are per person and inclusive of 7% VAT. Rates are applicable for ALL MARKET. Tickets are non-refundable and non-exchangeable. Eligibility Child rate applies to guests with height between 101–140 cm (40–55 inches) inclusive, regardless of age. Infants aged 0–4 years or with a height under 100 cm are free of charge for the ticket. Infants under 100 cm may attend the show free of charge but must share a seat with their parents during transfer. Attraction Access Show admission is included based on the selected ticket. Transfer service operates according to the schedule set by Phuket FantaSea only. Transportation is shared (non-private) and runs according to fixed time and trip schedules. Additional Information This is a shared transfer service. Pick-up location is available only for Phuket hotels. Infant may board the transfer free of charge; however, no seat will be provided. An infant car seat is mandatory and must be paid together with the transfer service directly at the onsite counter. Important Information for Share Transfer Please be ready at the main lobby at least 5 minutes before the scheduled pick-up time and present your Name and Reservation Code to our chauffeur before boarding. As shared transfers cannot wait more than 5 minutes, please be punctual. If you are unable to locate the driver, please contact the operator at (+66) 80 078 8256 At the pick-up time, the driver will display a signboard with “Phuket FantaSea / Carnival Magic.” Both attractions (Carnival Magic and Phuket FantaSea) share the same transfer service managed by Phuket FantaSea. The vans can be easily recognized by their pink and grey colors and the attraction logos displayed on the vehicles. Important Notes Transfer service is mandatory for infants and will be charged at THB 450 per person (round-trip). Please ensure all admission and eligibility requirements above are met prior to booking and visiting. How to Get There Taxi or private transfer are the most convenient ways to reach Phuket FantaSea. Some hotels offer shuttle services. Consider booking transportation in advance.
