globaltix_product_data.description: As Florence’s only royal palace, Palazzo Pitti is a must-see on the city’s tourist trail. It's also the largest museum complex in ; at some 32,000 m2 this is a residence fit for absolute rulers - from grand dukes to kings and emperors. The Palatine Gallery has works by Raphael, Titian, Rubens, and more. Skip the line and get into the Renaissance!Palazzo Pitti has come a long way since its original incarnation as the residence of ambitious banker Luca Pitti. Lavish touches adorn stunning architecture at this massive Renaissance palace on the banks of the Arno. Start your visit off like a Tuscan Duke by sidestepping the line-ups and waltzing right in.Once inside the palace’s beautiful royal apartments and you'll see an eclectic mix of sumptuous memorabilia including furniture, paintings, and fine sculpture. You'll also get an incredible sense of intimacy – decorated with glorious gilding and stucco, these are the rooms where the residents actually lived. And with beautiful period furnishings such as four-poster beds (smaller than you might imagine), you really do get the feeling that you're among royalty.The Palatine Gallery melds four centuries of high-style Tuscan living with Renaissance and Baroque paintings. It includes beautiful artworks by Raphael, Titian, Rubens, Pietro da Cortona - and many more. In another flair of the personal, the Palatine Gallery isn't organized chronologically, nor by school of painting. Instead, the arrangement reflects the tastes of the former residents. A visit to the Palazzo Pitti and Palatine Gallery will give you a sense of the everyday opulence of the aristocratic families who called the shots during the Renaissance. To get the most out of your visit, we suggest picking up a fur-trimmed velvet robe to wear as you swan through the halls.Don't miss the exhibition, which translates as "Homage to the Grand Duke. Memories of the Feasts of St. John" at the Treasury of the Grand Duke of Palazzo Pitti. Learn about little-known Italian goldsmiths of the 17th and 18th centuries and see some amazing plates and silverware.

Visit the sumptuous royal apartments, once home to the Grand Dukes of Tuscany
Get lost in the enchanting Boboli Gardens and he equally delightful Bardini Gardens

globaltix_product_data.description: Get ready for an unforgettable adventure just an hour from Barcelona, along the stunning Mediterranean coast. With this exclusive combo ticket, skip the lines and enjoy access to two of Europe’s top parks: PortAventura Park and Ferrari Land. Explore PortAventura’s six immersive themed worlds, featuring over 40 thrilling rides and 5 km of rollercoasters. Whether you’re visiting with family, friends, or a partner, the park offers something for everyone—spectacular attractions, live shows, and a wide range of dining options. Dive into a world of excitement and create lasting memories. At Ferrari Land, get ready for exhilarating thrills on Red Force, Europe’s tallest and fastest roller coaster, and enjoy other adrenaline-pumping attractions like Thrill Towers, Flying Dreams, and Racing Legends. globaltix_product_data.name: Prado Museum Guided Tour
globaltix_product_data.summary: The Prado Museum is one of the world's greatest art museums — a collection of European painting and sculpture assembled by the Spanish Crown over three centuries that stands as an unparalleled concentration of artistic genius, encompassing the world's finest collection of Spanish painting alongside...
globaltix_product_data.description: The Prado Museum is one of the world's greatest art museums — a collection of European painting and sculpture assembled by the Spanish Crown over three centuries that stands as an unparalleled concentration of artistic genius, encompassing the world's finest collection of Spanish painting alongside exceptional holdings of Flemish, Italian, and Dutch masters that together constitute a comprehensive survey of European art from the 12th to the 19th century. The Amigo Tours guided experience transforms what can be an overwhelming encounter with over 8,000 works into a carefully curated and deeply rewarding journey through the museum's most significant and historically resonant masterpieces. The guided tour focuses on the Prado's most celebrated treasures — Velázquez's Las Meninas, considered by many art historians the greatest painting ever created, Goya's devastating Black Paintings and the confrontational Third of May 1808, El Greco's spiritual intensity in The Trinity, and Hieronymus Bosch's bewildering The Garden of Earthly Delights among the works that receive the guide's most detailed and illuminating attention. The expert commentary contextualises each work within the broader history of European art and the specific cultural and political circumstances of the Spanish court that commissioned and collected these extraordinary paintings.

Enjoy an enriching experience guided by an expert
Enjoy expert commentary from a professional licensed guide
Discover the fascinating stories behind each artwork
Learn about royal portraits, religious, and mythological scenes
Admire masterpieces by Velázquez, Goya, El Greco, and Rubens
Visit lesser-known corners of the museum with hidden gems

globaltix_product_data.summary: Take a 2.5-hour guided tour of the most important cultural institutions in the Czech Republic. globaltix_product_data.description: Take a 2.5-hour guided tour of the most important cultural institutions in the Czech Republic. The expansive Prague Castle was once the heart of the Holy Roman Empire, and is now home to the Czech president and crown jewels.Your 2.5-hour guided tour begins at the Charles Bridge, where your guide will give you a short overview of the history of the enormous castle looming over the city.And then you'll cross the famous Charles Bridge, head to Lesser Town Square, and hop a tram to Prague Castle proper. With an area of almost 70,000 m², the Guinness Book of World Records, calls Prague Castle the largest coherent castle complex in the world. So the energy that tram ride will save you will give you more pep in your step as your guide shows you around the key sites. When you enter St. Vitus Cathedral you’ll hear stories about princes, kings, and emperors, and the ceremonial history of the site, and its remarkable stained glass windows. Your tour will also include the Old Royal Palace, Vladislav Hall, and St. George's Basilica - the oldest church onsite.Another highlight is the area known as Golden Lane, where you'll gain insight into the residents and activities of this storied area.Prague Castle has undergone various rebuilds, renovations, fires and was also the site of the Second Prague Defenestration - an act that led to the Bohemian Revolt. It's chock-full of history, quirks and stories, and the guide will shed light on its history and significance.
highlights: Explore majestic Prague Castle with an insightful guide
Take a tram ride up to the castle from the Lesser Town Square
Hear stories about the city from the 9th to the 20th century
inclusions: Access to St. Vitus Cathedral, Old Royal Palace, St. George’s Basilica and Golden Lane

globaltix_product_data.summary: Waiting in line to visit a clock is a paradox of wasted time folding in upon itself. globaltix_product_data.description: Waiting in line to visit a clock is a paradox of wasted time folding in upon itself. Of course, when that clock is a 600-year-old marvel of medieval engineering it's worth it. However, this skip-the-line ticket gets you right to the front of the line, so you can visit the Gothic clock tower, and see the insides of the world's oldest operational astronomical clock.Time flies when you're having fun, so make sure you get into the fast lane to see Prague's world-famous Astronomical Clock. Meet your guide in the quaint Old Town Square to pick up your tickets. Rain or shine, the guide will be holding an open blue and white umbrella. And then visit the clock. Every hour a small trapdoor opens and Christ himself marches out, followed by his disciples. The Grim Reaper also rings a bell - checking to see whose time has come (unsurprisingly, everyone shakes their heads 'no'). There are also planetary motion, the zodiac and more on the clock - and 75% of its parts are original - like original.With your tickets, you'll get to skip the lines and take the stairs or an elevator up the tower. From there you'll have amazing views over the Old Town Square and the rest of Prague's Old Town.On your way back down to Prague, you can think on the staying power of this clock. It's an appropriate occasion to call to mind the words of English essayist Henry Austin Dobson: we .That ought to encourage you to make the most of your time in Prague.
highlights: Get a short introduction in English to the history, significance, and meaning of this remarkable piece of medieval engineering
See the famous 600-year-old astronomical clock on your own and skip the long lines to get into its tower
Get spectacular views of the City of a Thousand Spires from the top
inclusions: Skip-the-line access to the clock tower
Short intro in English on the history of the venue

Qasr Al Watan houses the offices of the President, Vice President and Crown Prince of Abu Dhabi. Qasr Al Watan is the epitome of beauty, grace and marvelous architecture. You would get to visit the beautiful rooms of the palace including the library, the Great Hall, the Barza (the royal banquet), etc. You would also be able to attend interactive cultural exhibitions, view rare manuscripts and artifacts, and witness the contribution of Arabs in the fields of humanities, science, literature and arts. globaltix_product_data.description: Rainforest Wild Adventure (formerly Rainforest Wild ASIA) is Asia’s first adventure -based wildlife park at Mandai Wildlife Reserve. Its second phase (E AST zo ne) will soft open on 20 May 2026, allowing guests to explore a full 20 - hectare rainforest experience featuring habitats from Asia and Africa. Rainforest Wild ASIA will be renamed Rainforest Wild Adventure with effect from 20 May 2026. While the park consists of two separate zones (EAST & WEST), they are collectively branded under one name. The name "Rainforest Wild ASIA" will be discontinued from that date.
highlights: Explore an immersive rainforest attraction with lush landscapes, wildlife encounters, and interactive nature trails.
Experience diverse Asian ecosystems with themed zones showcasing unique flora, fauna, and conservation stories.
Perfect for families, nature lovers, and adventure seekers looking for an educational outdoor experience.
Includes access to themed trails, wildlife exhibits, and interactive experiences within the attraction.
Ideal for visitors of all ages seeking a blend of adventure, learning, and nature exploration.
globaltix_product_data.termsAndConditions: To participate in the Black Adventure, you must satisfy all following criteria: Minimum height: 1.35m. Maximum height: 2.1m. Minimum weight: 20kg. Maximum weight: 120kg. Able to climb and descend ladders, and walk on uneven terrain without any assistance. Able to fit securely into the harness provided. Not under the influence of drugs/alcohol. For your own safety, you will not be allowed to participate in the Black Adventure if you have/are: Pregnant Heart conditions High or low blood pressure Recovering from surgery or still in a cast or brace for support History of neck, back, knee or ankle injuries or any other physical limitations Frailor brittle-boned Susceptible to panic or anxiety attacks Pre-existing health or medical conditions Conditions for a safe adventure experience: Sports attire and sports shoes are required. Bring a water bottle. Mobile phones must be properly secured. No slippers, sandals and loose-fitting footwear. No loose or dangling items and jewellery. No sharp objects, selfie sticks or tripods. You must be in good health and free from any health or medical conditions, injuries or physical impairments. Please seek medical advice if uncertain. Mandai Wildlife Group (MWG) reserves the right at its sole discretion to stop your participation in the activity at any time.

options.name: [Opening Promo] Rainforest Wild Adventure Admission - Peak Period
options.description: Important Informations Rainforest Wild Asia is expected to experience high visitor volume on 18 July 2026 (Saturday) due to a large-scale event. Guests are encouraged to visit on an alternative date or consider visiting other Mandai parks, which will operate as usual. Longer waiting times should be expected on this date. Operating Hours: Open daily, 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM. Last admission at 5:00 PM. Location: 20 Mandai Lake Road, Singapore 729825. Enjoy opening special promotion of up to 9 Adventure+ activities included in your admission, from now till 31 Aug 2026! Peak Period (Saturdays, Sundays, and Singapore Public Holidays) - Admission includes up to 5 Adventure+ activities. Regular Period (Mondays to Fridays, excluding Singapore Public Holidays) - Admission includes up to 9 Adventure+ activities. Please click HERE to view the official Singapore Public Holidays
options.termsAndConditions: Children aged 0–2 years old enter free of charge. Child tickets are applicable for guests aged 3–12 years old. Guests are advised not to wear strong-scented perfume or fragrance, as animals are sensitive to strong odours. Feeding of animals is strictly prohibited unless explicitly permitted by park staff. Entry is subject to park capacity. Guests may be required to wait for admission during peak periods. Complimentary WiFi is available within the park. Guests with pre-existing medical conditions, heart or blood pressure conditions, brittle bones, or who are pregnant, recovering from surgery, or susceptible to panic or anxiety attacks are not permitted to participate in Black Adventure activities. All wildlife encounters within the park are chance encounters and are subject to variation based on time of visit, location, and environmental conditions. Mandai Wildlife Group reserves the right to modify park operations, activities, and animal habitats without prior notice. STB-Licensed Tourist Guide / Tour Leader Complimentary Admission Complimentary Admission Eligibility: 1. STB-Licensed Tourist Guides Tourist guides holding a valid Singapore Tourism Board (STB) Tourist Guide licence are entitled to complimentary admission upon presentation of their valid licence at the point of entry, subject to verification. 2. Tour Leaders One (1) complimentary ticket will be issued for every fifteen (15) paying guests. A maximum of four (4) complimentary tickets may be issued per tour group. Advance Registration Requirements: 3. Complimentary admission for Tour Leaders must be requested in advance. 4. Proof of identity for each Tour Leader and the group booking order must be submitted to the Reservations Team at least three (3) working days before the group's visit date. 5. Complimentary tickets will be issued via the Reseller Portal before the group's arrival. 6. Tour Leaders must present the complimentary ticket at the entrance for admission. Admission Conditions: 7. Admission is subject to verification and approval by the operator. 8. The operator reserves the right to refuse or limit entry if the eligibility requirements are not met. 9. Complimentary Tour Leader tickets are based on a minimum of fifteen (15) paying guests for the same park within a single transaction. Multiple parks or separate transactions cannot be combined for qualification purposes. Exclusions 10. Complimentary admission to Rainforest Wild ASIA does not include access to paid activities under Adventure Plus and Black Adventure. 11. Complimentary admission to River Wonders does not include access to paid activities, including the Amazon River Quest ride.

globaltix_product_data.description: Rainforest Wild Adventure (formerly Rainforest Wild ASIA) is Asia’s first adventure -based wildlife park at Mandai Wildlife Reserve. Its second phase (E AST zo ne) will soft open on 20 May 2026, allowing guests to explore a full 20 - hectare rainforest experience featuring habitats from Asia and Africa. Rainforest Wild ASIA will be renamed Rainforest Wild Adventure with effect from 20 May 2026. While the park consists of two separate zones (EAST & WEST), they are collectively branded under one name. The name "Rainforest Wild ASIA" will be discontinued from that date.
highlights: Explore an immersive rainforest attraction with lush landscapes, wildlife encounters, and interactive nature trails.
Experience diverse Asian ecosystems with themed zones showcasing unique flora, fauna, and conservation stories.
Perfect for families, nature lovers, and adventure seekers looking for an educational outdoor experience.
Includes access to themed trails, wildlife exhibits, and interactive experiences within the attraction.
Ideal for visitors of all ages seeking a blend of adventure, learning, and nature exploration.

options.termsAndConditions: Children aged 0–2 years old enter free of charge. Child tickets are applicable for guests aged 3–12 years old. All wildlife encounters within the park are chance encounters and are subject to variation based on time of visit, location, and environmental conditions. Mandai Wildlife Group reserves the right to modify park operations, activities, and animal habitats without prior notice. Complimentary Tour Leader tickets are based on a minimum of fifteen (15) paying guests for the same park within a single transaction. Complimentary admission to Rainforest Wild ASIA does not include access to paid activities under Adventure Plus and Black Adventure. 11. Complimentary admission to River Wonders does not include access to paid activities, including the Amazon River Quest ride.

globaltix_product_data.summary: Have a wet and wild adventure at Ramayana Water Park in Pattaya! Visit Thailand’s largest water park and marvel at the lush greenery and mountainside views. globaltix_product_data.description: Have a wet and wild adventure at Ramayana Water Park in Pattaya! Visit Thailand’s largest water park and marvel at the lush greenery and mountainside views. Start your day by sliding down Mat Racer! Challenge your friends to a thrilling ride down this four-lane waterslide, then go on a loop de loop at the Spiral or take on the twists and turns of the Aquaconda. Try more relaxing rides, like the Lazy River, to cool down after all the fun under the sun. Enjoy a time with the little ones at Family Aqua-Play, or feed fish at the River Walk. Don't miss out on the Floating Village right at the heart of Ramayana!
highlights: Experience heart-pounding excitement on exhilarating rides like the Mat Racer, a four-lane waterslide perfect for challenging your friends.
Marvel at the lush greenery and mountainside views surrounding Ramayana Water Park, providing a stunning backdrop for your aquatic escapades
Take a break from the excitement with relaxing rides like the Lazy River, where you can float peacefully and cool down under the sun

globaltix_product_data.summary: Discover the beautiful city of Copenhagen with this open-air, double-decker bus! Hop on and off as much as you like at any of the conveniently located stops around the city. With 22 stops around the city, the bus stops near all of Copenhagen's attractions and must-see sights. From the second oldest...
globaltix_product_data.description: Discover the beautiful city of Copenhagen with this open-air, double-decker bus! Hop on and off as much as you like at any of the conveniently located stops around the city. With 22 stops around the city, the bus stops near all of Copenhagen's attractions and must-see sights. From the second oldest amusement park in the world, Tivoli, to the winter residence of the royal family, Amalienborg Palace, and many other top attractions. During the 60-minute boat tour, you’ll pass the colorful Nyhaven, the hip and happening Christianshavn, and even the world-famous statue of the Little Mermaid. Audio guide: Danish, English, French, German, Italian, Mandarin, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish, Swedish The bus operates from 09:00 with departures every 10-45 minutes The last departure from Central station/Tivoli Gardens is at 16:00 Meeting point: 16 Bernstorffsgade, 1577, Copenhagen Instructions: Show your smartphone ticket to the staff at boarding Bus stops are integrated with the city bus stops – look for a small sign for the sightseeing bus stop Once on board, download the app to see bus departure and arrival times, and current location
highlights: Free WiFi and audio guide onboard the open-top sightseeing bus
Unlimited hop-on hop-off bus for 24 hours in Copenhagen
Explore the wonderful canals with a relaxing canal cruise

globaltix_product_data.name: From Vik: Katla Ice Cave and Super Jeep Tour
globaltix_product_data.summary: Venture into Iceland’s rugged wilderness on a guided tour in a Super Jeep from Vik. Visit an ice cave and learn about the volcanic and glacial forces that shaped the Land of Fire and Ice.
globaltix_product_data.description: Venture into Iceland’s rugged wilderness on a guided tour in a Super Jeep from Vik. Visit an ice cave and learn about the volcanic and glacial forces that shaped the Land of Fire and Ice.
highlights: Step into the interior of the Katla natural ice cave at Kötlujökull Glacier
Soak up the spectacular views of the majestic Mýrdalsjökull Ice Cap
Discover the South Coast's storied history and geology with your guide
Gaze at the natural wonders of Iceland's South Coast on a guided tour
Travel off-road through Iceland’s volcanic landscapes in a Super Jeep
inclusions: Visit to a natural ice cave
Safety equiptment (specialized glacier crampons, helmet, harness)
globaltix_product_data.termsAndConditions: Ice caves are one of nature’s most incredible wonders and part of what makes them so special is that they’re always changing. The Katla Ice Cave can look a bit different from week to week (or even day to day), depending on the weather, temperature, and natural ice movement. That means the cave you visit might not look exactly like the photos on our website, but that’s part of the adventure! No two visits are ever the same, and our guides will always take you to the most beautiful and safe spots available on the day of your tour. Thanks for embracing the magic of nature with us!

globaltix_product_data.termsAndConditions: All swimming stops are made at anchor. Guests can reach the shore by swimming. The catamarans depart at 10:00 AM. The boarding starts 30 minutes before the departure. Guests who miss the departure may be rebooked for another available day subject to availability and a rebooking fee of €25 per ticket. Please pay attention to the crew announcements regarding departure times during swimming stops. If you are unsure, feel free to ask a crew member for assistance. The captain reserves the right to modify the route or swimming stops due to weather or sea conditions for the safety and comfort of guests. During April, May, and October, if a catamaran does not reach the minimum required number of participants, the activity provider reserves the right to transfer guests to another luxury catamaran. Guests will be informed as soon as possible regarding any changes. For safety reasons, the crew reserves the right to refuse or stop the service of alcoholic beverages to intoxicated guests.
